Compress the path
to THE distinction into achievable timeframes.
RUIN/EDEN stepped back slightly.
"The synergies with your existing Principles are substantial," she
added.
"Perpetual Harvest amplifies every advancement occurring within Primus environments.
Cheating Architect allows manipulation of Primus Mana's fundamental properties for customized effects.
The three Principles create multiplicative rather than additive enhancement.
I am still pocking around for its locked features if there are any."
The Principle was a glorious one.
But even Singularity Principles seemed to have their own exceptionality as his own remained magisterial!

chapters.title: Chapter 4388 Primus! IV
paragraphs: Within Noah's mental weavings of existence, the endless blue ocean continued its transformation to blue-gold, waves of Primus Mana
cascading across impossible distances.
Three trees already stood tall...Perpetual Harvest with its green-gold radiance, Cheating Architect in pure gold geometry, and Primus Ascension blazing blue-gold.
But as Noah's consciousness focused, as RUIN/EDEN's analytical processes completed their assessments, two more trees began to bloom from the infinite ocean.
The first rose more slowly than the others, its light slightly dimmer. Where the Singularity Principles blazed with concentrated authority, this one pulsed with broader, more distributed power.
The Grand Principle of Mana Supremacy.
Its form was elegant, branches spreading wide rather than reaching high, each one connected to the others through intricate networks.

The tree shone with blue-purple light, and wherever its radiance touched the ocean below, the Primus Mana shifted, becoming supreme, asserting dominance over other forms of authority through pure conceptual weight.
And beside it, erupting from the ocean with sudden violence, the second tree manifested.
The Singularity Principle of Arcana Infinitum.

Its appearance was dramatic, pure blue light so deep it bordered on void, branches that looked more like reaching tendrils, roots that didn't just drink from the ocean but seemed to consume it, breaking down and rebuilding in endless cycles.
The tree pulsed with hunger that was purposeful, the appetite of transformation, the desire to break down all things and rebuild them
according to specific intent.
RUIN/EDEN's form shifted position, moving to stand between the two newly manifested Principles.
She was already in sync as she began to lay out the details right away!
GRAND PRINCIPLE OF MANA SUPREMACY - INTEGRATION ANALYSIS
Classification: Grand Principle (Distributable)|
Core Functionality: Authority Conversion Architecture
Primary Ability: [Mana Authority Conversion]]
Function: Transform any form of existential authority into Mana-based equivalent
Applications:
-Living Existential Authority to Living Existential Mana Authority -Dead Existential Authority to Dead Existential Mana Authority...etc
Effect: All converted authorities operate under Mana framework, making them compatible with Master's enhancement systems]
Civilization Impact: Citizens can convert their native authorities to Mana-based versions
Secondary Ability: [Supremacy Field Projection]
Function: Establish zones where Mana-based authorities
automatically dominate non-Mana equivalents
Range: Scales with complexity, current coverage is domain currently in+ 2 surrounding Transcendent Folds +50,000 Gigaparsecs in the surroundings
Effect: Within field, Mana-based techniques receive 3x effectiveness while non-Mana techniques face 50% reduction
Tactical Application: Transform battlefields into territory where your
Civilization's Mana-based capabilities overwhelm traditionally superior forces
Tertiary Ability: [Resource Conversion Matrix]
Function: Transform treasures, Sacred Herbs, and existential
materials into Mana-attuned equivalents
Efficiency: 1:1 conversion ratio with quality preservation
Application: Resources incompatible with Mana cultivation become immediately useful. Foreign treasures become Civilization assets
through systematic conversion
Economic Impact: Eliminates resource type restrictions, everything becomes potentially valuable through conversion capability
Ultimate Ability: [Supreme Mana Dominion Fold Declaration]]
Function: Designate a specific conceptual domain and transform it into a Fold under Mana Supremacy|
Effect: The formation of a Fold based on Mana.
Duration: Permanent until consciously revoked
Limitation: Can maintain 3 simultaneous domain designations at
current complexity
LOCKED FEATURES - MANA SUPREMACY
[Fold Conversion Protocol] - Requires 50 Quintillion Complexity
Convert entire unique Folds to operate under full Mana Supremacy framework
Effect: Claimed territories where all authorities automatically become Mana-based
[Supremacy Inheritance] - Requires 100 Quintillion Complexity
Beings born within your Supremacy fields automatically possess Mana-based authorities from inception
Effect: Eliminates conversion necessity for new generations, they emerge already aligned with your Way. Into your Civilization.
The capabilities of this Grand Principle...were unfathomably grand!
But it was not alone.
Noah adapted to its wonders as he thought of all the possibilities, and
his gaze moved over.
RUINEDEN's focus shifted to the second tree, the void-like blue of Arcana Infinitum pulsing with hungry potential.
SINGULARITY PRINCIPLE OF ARCANA INFINITUM - INTEGRATION
ANALYSIS
Classification: Singularity Principle (Exclusive)
Core Functionality: Consumption and Conversion Architecture
Primary Ability: [Existential Consumption]
Function: Devour any existence, resource, or concept to fuel
advancement
Mechanism: Consumed targets broken down to fundamental components, then rebuilt as advancement fuel specifically calibrated
to current bottlenecks
Application: Systematic consumption of defeated enemies, obsolete resources, or even deprecated territories converts everything into usable advancement fuel
Secondary Ability: [Hardship Dissolution]]
Function: Identify advancement bottlenecks and provide direct
solutions through consumption
Examples:
-Glyph formation difficulty: Consume relevant concepts to gain
understanding
|-Principle maturation stagnation: Consume related Principles from
other sources to accelerate development|
Effect: No advancement challenge remains unsolvable given sufficient resources to consume
Tertiary Ability: [Mana Arcana Glyph Forge]
Function: Consume resources to directly generate Mana Arcana
Glyphs Application: Systematic consumption of defeated enemies or harvested resources translates directly into Glyph accumulation
Current Limitation: Can forge maximum 10 Primus Mana Arcana Glyphs per day at current complexity, or 10,000 Primus Mana Arcana
Glyphs
Quaternary Ability: [Recursive Consumption Loop]|
Function: Consume your own deprecated systems or techniques to
fuel creation of superior replacements
Mechanism: Old Mana Glyphs consumed to accelerate formation of new Arcana Glyphs. Obsolete techniques broken down to provide
materials for advanced versions
Effect: Advancement becomes self-sustaining, each breakthrough provides fuel for next breakthrough through systematic recycling
Personal Impact: Eliminates resource scarcity as limiting factor, advancement limited only by time and theoretical understanding
Ultimate Ability: [Devouring Singularity]|
Function: Designate specific location as consumption focal point where all defeated enemies, expended resources, and environmental energy automatically funnels into Master's advancement
Duration: Permanent until consciously relocated

[Fold Consumption Protocol] - Requires 50 Quintillion Complexity
Consume entire Folds of Existence to fuel massive advancement
leaps
Effect: Deprecated or collapsed Folds become advancement
resources
[[Conceptual Devouring] - Requires 100 Quintillion Complexity
Consume Principles to integrate their fundamental nature into your existence, or just as weapons to break past a ceiling.
Effect: Consumed Principles become intrinsic capabilities rather than external manipulations
[THE Consumption Path] - ??? Complexity
Consume beings carrying THE distinction to extract and integrate
their Scale of Existence
Effect: Direct path to a false version of THE through systematic consumption of existing THE entity. Note- this is False. It is not The
Way.|
Requirement: Must successfully defeat and consume THE-level existences. Easy.
Risk Assessment: THE entities may resist consumption. RUIN/EDEN stepped back, her holographic form pulsing with satisfaction at comprehensive data delivery.
As for Noah... His tyrannical heart pulsed with determination.
Five Principles. Infinite Primus Mana. A Civilization ready to be systematically elevated. And now, tools to consume everything in his path and convert it into advancement toward THE.
It was magisterial!
His Isolated Civilization...Riya...they had given him much!

chapters.title: Chapter 4389 Ways I
paragraphs: Noah remained connected to Riya, the singularity above the Isolated Civilization blazing blue-gold brilliance that painted vast swathes of existence in enhanced authority.
But his consciousness had turned inward, sensing the continuing transformations coursing through his being as Primus Mana fundamentally restructured what he was at the deepest levels.
Five Principles now resided within him...Perpetual Harvest, Cheating Architect, Primus Ascension, Mana Supremacy, and Arcana Infinitum.
Each one representing capabilities that others could not imagine, tools that could elevate him and his Civilization toward heights that should have been impossible.
And yet, as he felt the weight of these capabilities settling into his completed Heart, a thought emerged.
If I possess these capabilities...these Principles that can rapidly elevate myself and my Civilization by tens of Quintillions, if I have all this even before achieving THE distinction...
How ridiculous must THE Dead Order actually be?
WAA!
The question spiraled through his consciousness.
THE Living Paradox. THE Living Emotive. THE Creature. Beings who already carry that distinction, who operate at scales I'm still heading towards.

If my Principles allow systematic elevation of entire Civilizations, what can beings with THE distinction accomplish? What grander tools do they possess that make my capabilities look quaint by comparison?
It was a heavy thought.
He thought of Kael and the forty-seven other Seed Members. He had given them his Way of Mana and then left them isolated for millions of subjective years.

And they had reached 50 Quintillion. Built a sophisticated Civilization. Developed techniques and systems that exceeded his own somewhat. That was just a few dozen beings following his Way of Existence!

So what about THE Living Paradox, who has been pioneering the Way of Paradox for eons? Who controls Principles at levels I do not know? Who leads a Civilization that's had uncounted ages to refine their approach?
His eyes flashed with a chilly, tyrannical light!
What has the Civilization of Paradox become in that time?
The implications cascaded through his mind!
Since Aethelgard...since they became serious about enacting their Civilization, about building THE Loom, what grand things have they accomplished?
Inside THE Loom, protected and isolated with resources, with multiple THE-level entities guiding development...

How grand has the Way of Paradox become? The Civilization of Emotive? The systems and techniques and principles they've refined? Noah's perception swept across his own Isolated Civilization...millions of beings, sophisticated systems, Repository of Formed Authority, the Bastion of Mana, all built through desperate necessity and infinite
resources.
And they only had a fraction of the time that THE Loom's inhabitants have possessed. Only a fraction of the guidance!
His tyrannical heart pulsed with uncomfortable realization.
I don't know.
I don't know what they've accomplished. Don't know what capabilities
they possess. Don't know what tools they've developed that might make even my Five Principles seem inadequate.
But this knowledge...
His consciousness focused with laser intensity.
This knowledge would be the key to understanding why I could possibly fail.
Riya saw the light of Mana dimming in her future perception even after everything they had accomplished.
This had to be rectified!
He needed to understand the true scope of what beings with THE distinction can accomplish when they've had eons to refine their Civilizations!
His eyes blazed with blue-gold light as the singularity above
continued pulsing.
One more thing to add to the endless list of problems requiring impossible solutions...
Far from the Wandering Territories.
On the other side of The Veil.
In the Lands of The Dead where existence itself operated under fundamentally different rules.
"I DEFY, THEREFORE I EXIST!"
The words boomed across dimensional boundaries, stretching through gaps and Tears of Existence with force.
"I REFUSE LIMITATIONS, THEREFORE I TRANSCEND!"
They echoed across vast distances, reaching territories that should
have been impossible to access from the living side of The Veil.
"I CULTIVATE INFINITY, THEREFORE... I NEED NOT FEAR THE END!"
The declarations reached even into a Cryptland...a vast necropolis-city where Prime Dead Early Creatures congregated in numbers that would have terrified most living beings.
Countless Dead Existences raised their heads in astonishment, their
empty eye sockets blazing with confused curiosity at words spoken with such tyrannical certainty that they penetrated even here.
None of them recognized the voice.
But one being did.

A being whose existence had traversed unfathomably far to even reach this distance where Dead Early Creatures were abundant...in territory that should have been impossible for a Living Existence to survive in, let alone explore.
But he was not a normal Existence!
The Great Usurper.
The Master of the Idle Gaming System.
His formless existence rippled with recognition as Noah's voice
echoed across The Veil.
Since the moment a Tear of Existence had allowed his Idle Existence
to leak into the other side of The Veil, things had unfolded in
shocking ways.
At that initial moments of crossover, grand prompts had bloomed
before his awareness as more and more of his Existence permeated across The Lands of The Dead
Your Idle Existence has extended sufficiently into the Lands of The Dead to achieve fundamental understanding of local operational parameters.
The Way of Order covers all of this side of The Veil. All of the Lands of The Dead operate under unified authority structure emanating from THE Dead Order herself.|
Your Idle Existence, due to its passive nature and evolutionary adaptations, has fully integrated with the landscape you have covered, being no different to the structure of existence itself.

Exposure to the pervasive Way of Order has triggered unprecedented evolution of your existential framework. So long as you maintain idle expansion with no active interference or conscious manipulation, you will remain indistinguishable from the surrounding existence itself.
Mechanism: Your passive spread mimics natural expansion of the
environment. To local existences, you are the environment, no
different from ambient space, atmospheric conditions, or background
authority.
Effect: Detection becomes functionally impossible.
WARNING: Any active action breaks this camouflage immediately.
Indistinguishable.
The Great Usurper had almost not believed the prompts when they
first appeared.
Nothing would be able to sense him? A Duke had detected him in the
Spirit Folds and nearly killed him for the intrusion.
The Lands of The Dead contained beings millions of times more
powerful than that Duke.
And yet they wouldn't sense him?
He had been skeptical.
Profoundly skeptical!
But he had remained Idle...that was his nature, after all. His existence
continued spreading in its formless state, expanding across the dead territories without conscious direction.
And shockingly, the speed at which he progressed seemed to
accelerate exponentially.
He spread across regions filled with aimless Dead Existences. Passed

through territories where undead entities congregated in vast numbers. Eventually reached this Cryptland where Early Creatures were abundant...powerful beings whose individual complexity would have crushed him if they'd noticed his presence.
And yet...
None sense me.
It was astonishing. Legitimately reality-defying.
Because his Idle Existence had become fundamentally indistinguishable from the surrounding environment, he was
perceived...or rather, not perceived, the same way ambient existence
was perceived.
It was akin to a normal human smelling air. To them, it was just
air...could be windy, calm, cold, hot, but it remained air regardless. Nothing remarkable. Nothing requiring specific attention.
At this moment, to the Dead Early Creatures and any other existence
in these lands, they would truly not be able to sense any difference in
their surroundings because nothing had inherently changed from
their perspective.
His presence was as unremarkable as the space between spaces.
My Idle Existence... seems to be slightly powerful?

To them, it was just
air...could be windy, calm, cold, hot, but it remained air regardless.
Nothing remarkable.
Nothing requiring specific attention.
At this moment, to the Dead Early Creatures and any other existence
in these lands, they would truly not be able to sense any difference in
their surroundings because nothing had inherently changed from
their perspective.
His presence was as unremarkable as the space between spaces.
My Idle Existence... seems to be slightly powerful?

chapters.title: Chapter 4390 Ways II
paragraphs: The Great Usurper smiled at the understatement!
This might be the most overpowered survival capability he'd ever developed...perfect invisibility through simply being part of the environment rather than a separate entity within it.
He continued not interfering with his expansion. Continued being idle, spreading across more of the Lands of The Dead with accelerating momentum.
Until...
"I defy, therefore I exist!
I refuse limitations, therefore I transcend!
I cultivate infinity, therefore...I need not fear the end!"
Until those words boomed across The Veil itself.
The Great Usurper's awareness focused with sharp attention.
He recognized Osmont swiftly.
I was talking to him just over a day ago, but I haven't checked in during the last 24 hours....
He wondered what could cause Noah's declarations to echo with such force that they penetrated across dimensional boundaries into the Lands of The Dead.
And as he contemplated this...
HUUM!
In the next instant, he sensed the appearance of a terrifically powerful Prime Dead Early Creature.
The being manifested above the grand Citadel of The Dead that dominated this Cryptland.
The entity floated there, listening to the fading echo of Noah's words with an expression that suggested... disapproval? Contemplation?
In the next moment, the being looked down at the grand citadel below and raised his hand.
Brilliant white light blazed from that raised palm...pure, crystalline Order that made the surrounding death-aspected existence recoil slightly from its presence.
When the being spoke, his voice carried the weight of absolute
conviction.
"The Way of Order has been refined," he declared. "The foundations have been examined. The impurities have been identified. And now..."
The white light intensified.
"Order is being reinforced as the backbone of this Civilization erected across the Lands of The Dead. You shall now brim with True
Order...not the chaotic semblance you have maintained, but the purified essence that THE Dead Order herself has ordained."
His gaze swept across the thousands of Prime Dead Early Creatures gathered below.
"Are you all ready to receive the True Civilization of Order?"
The Great Usurper observed in astonishment as all the Prime Dead Early Creatures in the citadel looked upward with expressions of profound reverence.

Their voices rose in perfect unison, synchronized with precision. "WE ARE READY TO RECEIVE THE TRUE CIVILIZATION OF ORDER!" The declaration shook the surrounding space, and the Great Usurper felt profound unease at the sheer fervor in their collective response. What sort of fanatical beings have I stumbled across? Why do they seem so intimately devoted to THE Dead Order?
Are they...even still in control of their own existences, or has something fundamental been altered about their nature?
To obtain more information, he stopped actively observing the newly appeared powerful entity...looked away, momentarily, allowing his Idle Existence to simply be rather than consciously perceiving.
And the moment he looked away, allowing passive observation to
resume...
Entity appearing in perception of Idle Existence has been catalogued.]
STATUS ASSESSMENT:
NAME: Meliodas]
CLASSIFICATION: Prime Dead Early Creature
COMPLEXITY: 100 Quintillion
PURITY: 100 Quintillion
DISTINCTIONS:
-Guider of Order]
-Herald of True Civilization
-Enforcer of THE Dead Order's Will
-Bearer of Systematic Reduction Authority
CURRENT ACTION: Implementing Civilization Restructuring Protocol
The Great Usurper's awareness reeled.
One hundred Quintillion?!
At most, the complexity he'd observed from other Prime Dead Early
Creatures had ranged from 1 to 3 Quintillion. Powerful, yes, but
nothing approaching this magnitude.
Who is this entity that he holds such terrifying power?
He returned to actively observing Meliodas, and what he witnessed made his formless existence ripple with shock.
From the being's raised hand, a beam of resplendent white Order radiated outward and descended like a raging sea of crystalline
calmness.
It washed over the entire Citadel of The Dead below, bathing thousands of Prime Dead Early Creatures in its luminescence. But the effect wasn't what the Great Usurper expected.
The undead beings didn't explode with enhanced power. Didn't receive boons or elevation.
Instead, one by one, their entire existences began to diminish.
The white light of Order stripped their complexity away. Reduced their purity systematically.
The Prime Dead Early Creatures...beings of substantial power, were having their very essence drained by the descending authority.
And they stood there. Accepting it. Faces showing nothing but reverent gratitude.
The Great Usurper looked away again, discomfort making him avoid direct observation.
Prompts bloomed immediately:
Order is establishing itself fully and thoroughly across this territory.
The Edict that Meliodas has come to enforce is designated: TRUE ORDER PROTOCOL
As ordained by THE Dead Order herself, this protocol restructures power distribution across affiliated territories.]
Too many existences possessing high Complexity and Purity creates chaos. Leads to disorder and disunity as countless entities gain capability to alter existence according to individual whims.
True Order strips this distributed power in favor of concentrated
authority held by select few.
RESTRUCTURED HIERARCHY:
|-Selective few (Guiders, Heralds, Enforcers) retain overwhelming
capability to alter existence]
-These entities act as Beacons of Order who will protect those
without power
-Majority population reduced to minimal complexity (1 or less)
-Power concentration allows unified direction, elimination of
conflicting authorities]
JUSTIFICATION:
This is Order. Not democracy of power, but hierarchy of purpose. A

single, select few holding existential authority ensures that through them, Order can be maintained without the chaos of competing wills. Reduced complexity from reduced population increases the parameters of Guiders exponentially and proportionally, ignoring the set Ceiling.
Estimated gain: +25 Quintillion from this single Citadel.]
The Great Usurper turned back to witness the conclusion of the
process.
Every Prime Dead Early Creature in the Citadel....hundreds of powerful
beings, now emanated the complexity and authority of...
One.
Not 1 Quintillion. Not 1 Trillion or Billion or even 1 Million.
One. Uno. Eins. Un. Ichi.
One singular unit of complexity and purity.
Beings who had possessed the power to reshape territories were now reduced to the existential weight of... nothing.
And yet their eyes remained fervent with belief. Faces showing nothing but satisfaction, as if this reduction was not just acceptable
but desired.
Their expressions were identical...reverence that suggested something far more disturbing than simple loyalty. Are these fuckers still in control of their own existence?
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 4391 Ways III
paragraphs: The Great Usurper's formless awareness pulsed with profound discomfort.

Anyone having their power stripped away would show at least some emotion. Resistance, anger, fear, sadness...something. These Dead Existences act like it's not just normal but ordained. They didn't show even a flicker of hesitation....

Is their existence being influenced? Controlled? Have they been fundamentally altered to accept this hierarchy without question? He didn't know for certain, but the implications were deeply unsettling.
Meanwhile, Meliodas floated above the restructured Citadel, and the Great Usurper sensed his complexity had indeed increased...from 100 Quintillion to approximately 125 Quintillion.
Not because he directly absorbed this power. It was as if his very action and what it accomplished triggered something from his...so called Civilization.
Crazy...
The Great Usurper's awareness rippled with fascination.
So this is what THE Dead Order's True Civilization looks like. Systematic reduction of the many to empower the few...
They've eliminated individual will in favor of synchronized purpose.
He contemplated what he'd witnessed...the zealotry, the systematic power drainage, the absolute acceptance of reduction from powerful beings to effective nothingness.
What kind of reality are we facing if this is just one Citadel? How many of these restructured territories exist across the Lands of The Dead?
The questions spiraled through his consciousness without comfortable answers.
He remained Idle, his existence continuing to spread passively.
Let's see...what Osmont knows about this. His voice reached even here, perhaps he has intelligence about what's happening on this side of The Veil. And if not...
His formless awareness pulsed with determination.
Then I'll continue observing. Continue spreading. Eventually, I'll learn enough about THE Dead Order's True Civilization to understand...ah, the Idle life is a great life...
The Great Usurper continued his idle expansion, his awareness drinking in every detail of this restructured Citadel while maintaining perfect invisibility through his environmental integration.
Whatever was coming, he would gather intelligence.
And hopefully, share it with Osmont before the accumulated knowledge became desperately necessary for survival.
That guy was the craziest existence he had ever met, if anything crazy was happening, he should be able to deal with it!
In a unique domain that could not be pinned to any specific location
within observable existence, Noah's declarations echoed with profound resonance.
"I defy, therefore I exist!
I refuse limitations, therefore I transcend!
I cultivate infinity, therefore...I need not fear the end!"
The words reverberated through a space of utmost Law.
The domain itself was hazy, ethereal in ways that made normal perception struggle to maintain focus.

Silver-white marble pillars rose from equally pristine floors, their surfaces so smooth they reflected nothing despite the abundant light. The sky above roiled with clouds of mist that moved with purpose rather than wind, and white fog covered the surroundings in layers. Here, in this domain of absolute Law, two figures sat cross-legged on the marble floor.
The young woman appeared apprehensive, her posture suggesting uncertainty mixed with awe at their surroundings.
The young man beside her maintained calm sternness, his features composed despite whatever transformation had brought them to this impossible place.
Both had undergone profound changes. Their bodies were drenched in silver-white brilliance of pure Law, hair shining with that same metallic luminescence.
On their chests, complex Enneagrams spun with rhythmic precision!
These two were...Alexander Asmodeus and Seraphina Valorheart!
The two holders of The Enneagram.
They turned simultaneously, looking around as Noah's declarations faded, and surprise flashed through Alexander's eyes.
"That voice..." he murmured, recognition coloring his tone.
Before they could contemplate this further, another voice emerged from ahead of where they sat.
"It seems that even in this era, others are also trying to pioneer their Way. If only it was not too late. If only...
The voice carried terrifically heavy weight...infallible majesty mixed with profound sorrow that made the surrounding Law ripple.
It emanated from a cluster of extremely concentrated Living Law
authority...a singularity of silver-white brilliance that pulsed with the accumulated wisdom of eons.
Seraphina's apprehension transformed into respect as she spoke
carefully.
"O Remnant Will of THE Living Law," she said, bowing her head
slightly, "what do you mean by... The Way?"
The singularity pulsed, and when it spoke again, the words carried
simplicity.

"The Way," it began, each word making the surrounding Law resonate, "is the fundamental path an existence forges through reality. Not merely techniques or power accumulation, but the essential how of one's being...the framework through which you interact with and alter existence itself."
The silver-white light intensified slightly.

"My Way of Law was crushed eons ago during the formation of THE Loom. THE Living Paradox, may he burn in hellish Scales of Existence...dismantled my Civilization, shattered my frameworks, and used the brilliance of what I had built as raw material to form the backbone of others' dreams."
Something like bitter acceptance entered the voice.
"The Way is both key and building blocks of any true Civilization. It is
the primary mechanism through which existence advances forward. Through it, beings transform from scattered individuals into unified purpose. Through it, power compounds rather than simply
accumulates."
The singularity dimmed slightly, as if the act of explanation cost it
energy.

"But understand this critical truth: in the forging of Civilizations within THE Loom, all those who remain outside can be considered nothing more than fuel. THE Loom will erupt as the weapon of The Fallout...it will accomplish this by siphoning off all glimmers and signs
of Civilizations external to itself."
HUUUM!
The weight of those words settled across the domain.
"That voice you just heard, the entity declaring defiance and

infinity...his forming Way and Civilization will simply become fuel for THE Loom when the time comes. It is akin to someone working diligently to prepare a magnificent meal, not knowing that soon, a force will arrive to extinguish them and slowly savor that meal in their
place."
The Remnant Will pulsed with sorrow.
"That is what lies in store for all of existence outside THE Loom. All

those embarking upon their Way of Existence, building their Civilizations with hope and determination, not understanding they are merely cultivating resources for others to harvest. It is truly... a sad affair."

chapters.title: Chapter 4392 Ways IV
paragraphs: Alexander's gaze blazed with a defiant light even as his external composure remained stern.

Doom and gloom. Everyone speaks of inevitable catastrophe as if accepting failure before the battle even begins. As if preparation itself is pointless because the outcome is predetermined. I refuse this narrative!
He spoke aloud, his voice cutting through the oppressive atmosphere gloriously.
"I care not for all these talks of doom and gloom that everyone seems set to perpetuate," Alexander said, his tone holding admonishment that made Seraphina's eyes widen with shock.
"Were you not a supposed leader of your Civilization? You were grand. You were bright. How can you sit here and speak like this...as if defeat is the only possible outcome?"
He leaned forward slightly, his Enneagram spinning faster.

"Let us speak of solutions rather than constant death. If you possess knowledge, share strategies rather than lamentations. If you understand THE Loom's mechanisms, explain weaknesses rather than inevitabilities. Otherwise, what purpose does this conversation serve beyond spreading despair?"
HUUM!
Seraphina turned to Alexander in shock, her expression showing she wanted to tell him not to speak to The Remnant Will of THE Living Law with such directness!
But his gaze, steady and unflinching...caused her eyes to flicker uncertainly.
She looked down and stayed silent.
At such direct challenge, the singularity of brilliance flashed and released what might have been a sigh.

"Very well," it said, "Perhaps defiance is more appropriate than acceptance. The only thing I have left to give is the skeletal structure of My Way. My Civilization's foundational architecture. Inherit it and see what you can accomplish with proper time and resources."
The light intensified suddenly.

"But oh... if only you had time. If only the timeline allowed for proper cultivation of what I'm about to bestow. Still...better to possess tools and insufficient time than face The Fallout empty-handed."
At such words, blinding light of pure Law descended upon Alexander Asmodeus and Seraphina Valorheart like a waterfall of compressed knowledge!
The Wandering Territories.
Inside the Isolated Civilization.
In skies filled with blue-gold Mana, Noah continued spinning slowly while holding the figure of Riya, who had wrapped her arms around his head like a determined octopus refusing to release its prey.

But his internal existence buzzed with waves of new information because while all this external activity occurred, while his existence continued transforming with Primus Mana coursing through every particle of his being...
He was actually having a conversation with The Great Usurper, Eckert.
This was one of the grandeur of more complex existence...one could seemingly be doing a large number of things simultaneously within the same few seconds or minutes!
Within his mind, in that mental seascape, another area of calm sea of blue-gold stretched endlessly.
An illusory form of Noah stood above its surface, and beside him, an illusory form of a man in his mid-twenties with dark blue hair stood casually.

They both stared into the sea below, which displayed scenes The Great Usurper had transmitted... images of the other side of The Veil where Meliodas, the Guider of Order, had imposed True Order upon an entire Citadel, systematically reducing thousands of Prime Dead Early Creatures to complexity of 1.
Noah's stern gaze remained fixed on those scenes as he spoke with quiet intensity.
"THE Dead Order is a terrifying thing," he said, "The fact that your existence has somehow escaped the line of sight of an entity at her level is ridiculous enough..."
He turned to look at Eckert directly.
The moment he stepped foot on the other Side of The Veil, THE Dead Order senses him and carries out a fever dream of a horrendous
future where he is used as a fucking battery. But Eckert...
"How are you doing that, by the way? What mechanism allows your Existence to remain undetected by beings who should perceive everything within their domains?"
Eckert smiled with amusement, at such a question.
"Bro," he said, "have you ever told me the deepest secrets of your existence and how it works? Explained every mechanism of your
power?"
Noah raised his eyebrows, then nodded calmly.
"Each of us have our own Way," he conceded.
At such words, Eckert's eyes lit up with sudden interest.
"Oh yeah, what is this stuff about The Way? Civilizations? I keep
hearing these terms, but nobody's explained what they actually mean
in practical terms."
Noah contemplated for a moment, organizing his understanding into communicable form.
"The Way of Existence," he began, "is the essential framework through
which you interact with and alter reality. The lens through which existence perceives you and through which you perceive existence."
He gestured at the blue-gold sea beneath them.
"My Way is The Mana Architect. The Way of Mana. Everything I do...every technique, every advancement, every interaction with reality... operates through the framework of Mana as fundamental
building block. It is My Way."
HUUM!
His expression became more serious.
"And a Civilization is what happens when multiple beings adopt a compatible Way and create unified structure...well, something like that. I have only just began to build my Civilization."
Wherever he thought of The Way of Existence, his mind came to the visage of Anaximander and his words.
He could potentially call out to that being, with a heavy question being what had happened to him since The Earliest Folds. What had occured between such an anomaly and THE Weavers?
After Eckert listened to his words carefully, his eyes shone with unique understanding.
"The Way..." he murmured, processing the implications. "So My Way would be... eh, I won't actively look for it. I'll remain idle, as I'm sure
My Way will declare itself naturally through that very inaction.
Hmm..."
His eyes pulsed with power that suggested his Idle Existence was already more profound than he consciously realized.
Noah looked at him with analytical focus.
"Be careful," he said quietly. "You are an anomaly in your own right,
yes. But many anomalies have fallen to existences with THE distinction. Power alone doesn't guarantee survival when facing beings who've refined their Civilizations for eons."
WAA!

Seraphina turned to Alexander in shock, her expression showing she wanted to tell him not to speak to The Remnant Will of THE Living Law with such directness!
But his gaze, steady and unflinching...caused her eyes to flicker uncertainly.
She looked down and stayed silent.
At such direct challenge, the singularity of brilliance flashed and released what might have been a sigh.
"Very well," it said, "Perhaps defiance is more appropriate than acceptance.
The only thing I have left to give is the skeletal structure of My Way.
My Civilization's foundational architecture.
Inherit it and see what you can accomplish with proper time and resources."
The light intensified suddenly.
"But oh... if only you had time.
If only the timeline allowed for proper cultivation of what I'm about to bestow.
Still...better to possess tools and insufficient time than face The Fallout empty-handed."
At such words, blinding light of pure Law descended upon Alexander Asmodeus and Seraphina Valorheart like a waterfall of compressed knowledge!
The Wandering Territories.
Inside the Isolated Civilization.
In skies filled with blue-gold Mana, Noah continued spinning slowly while holding the figure of Riya, who had wrapped her arms around his head like a determined octopus refusing to release its prey.

But his internal existence buzzed with waves of new information because while all this external activity occurred, while his existence continued transforming with Primus Mana coursing through every particle of his being...
He was actually having a conversation with The Great Usurper, Eckert.
This was one of the grandeur of more complex existence...one could seemingly be doing a large number of things simultaneously within the same few seconds or minutes!
Within his mind, in that mental seascape, another area of calm sea of blue-gold stretched endlessly.
An illusory form of Noah stood above its surface, and beside him, an illusory form of a man in his mid-twenties with dark blue hair stood casually.

They both stared into the sea below, which displayed scenes The Great Usurper had transmitted... images of the other side of The Veil where Meliodas, the Guider of Order, had imposed True Order upon an entire Citadel, systematically reducing thousands of Prime Dead Early Creatures to complexity of 1.
Noah's stern gaze remained fixed on those scenes as he spoke with quiet intensity.
"THE Dead Order is a terrifying thing," he said, "The fact that your existence has somehow escaped the line of sight of an entity at her level is ridiculous enough..."
He turned to look at Eckert directly.
The moment he stepped foot on the other Side of The Veil, THE Dead Order senses him and carries out a fever dream of a horrendous
future where he is used as a fucking battery.
But Eckert...
"How are you doing that, by the way?
What mechanism allows your Existence to remain undetected by beings who should perceive everything within their domains?"
Eckert smiled with amusement, at such a question.
"Bro," he said, "have you ever told me the deepest secrets of your existence and how it works?
Explained every mechanism of your
power?"
Noah raised his eyebrows, then nodded calmly.
"Each of us have our own Way," he conceded.
At such words, Eckert's eyes lit up with sudden interest.
"Oh yeah, what is this stuff about The Way?
Civilizations?
I keep
hearing these terms, but nobody's explained what they actually mean
in practical terms."
Noah contemplated for a moment, organizing his understanding into communicable form.
"The Way of Existence," he began, "is the essential framework through
which you interact with and alter reality.
The lens through which existence perceives you and through which you perceive existence."
He gestured at the blue-gold sea beneath them.
"My Way is The Mana Architect.
The Way of Mana.
Everything I do...every technique, every advancement, every interaction with reality... operates through the framework of Mana as fundamental
building block.
It is My Way."
HUUM!
His expression became more serious.
"And a Civilization is what happens when multiple beings adopt a compatible Way and create unified structure...well, something like that.
I have only just began to build my Civilization."
Wherever he thought of The Way of Existence, his mind came to the visage of Anaximander and his words.
He could potentially call out to that being, with a heavy question being what had happened to him since The Earliest Folds.
What had occured between such an anomaly and THE Weavers?
After Eckert listened to his words carefully, his eyes shone with unique understanding.
"The Way..." he murmured, processing the implications.
"So My Way would be... eh, I won't actively look for it.
I'll remain idle, as I'm sure
My Way will declare itself naturally through that very inaction.
Hmm..."
His eyes pulsed with power that suggested his Idle Existence was already more profound than he consciously realized.
Noah looked at him with analytical focus.
"Be careful," he said quietly.
"You are an anomaly in your own right,
yes.
But many anomalies have fallen to existences with THE distinction.
Power alone doesn't guarantee survival when facing beings who've refined their Civilizations for eons."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 4393 Ways V
paragraphs: His expression hardened.

"As for me... I have a war coming against THE Dead Order and her forces. Whatever this conflict brings may be key to surviving The Fallout...either by defeating her and devouring everything she has, or by gaining sufficient intelligence about beings like her and their capabilities to prepare appropriate counters. Oh, and let me know if you pick up anything regarding THE Creature. The Dead regard him as Dead, but I havent discovered much of their weavings."
At such words, The Great Usurper nodded.

"I'll keep an eye out on the other side of The Veil," he said. "My Idle Existence can spread undetected...might as well use that advantage for reconnaissance. If I see their armies marching, gathering for assault, I can at least warn you before they arrive."
Noah smiled and nodded.
"That information could be the difference between prepared defense and complete surprise."
Moments later, Eckert's illusory figure dissolved, their mental communication concluding.
Noah remained alone above the blue-gold sea, still observing the scene of Meliodas and the restructured Citadel where every entity had been reduced to complexity of 1.
Is this True Order? Reducing the number of entities who can impose their will upon existence, concentrating power in select few who act as unified authority?
Is this what THE Dead Order has been accomplishing this past day while I've been focused on my own advancement?
He had to acknowledge it...creating Prime Dead Early Creatures exceeding 100 Quintillion was impressive!
And Meliodas was likely only one among many. The enemies he would soon face would probably range into hundreds of Quintillion if not higher.
He sighed internally.
They were really going to make him work unfathomably hard for this.
But he did need more information, and...
And I've already called over the one who might be able to shed some more light on the distinction of THE...among other things.
She should actually be arriving...
"Now."
Noah's eyes flashed as he focused outwardly, his consciousness returning fully to his physical body.
He momentarily unlatched from Riya, breaking their connection despite her obvious dissatisfaction.
She licked the residual saliva of concentrated Primus Mana from her lips, her jewel-blue eyes flashing with annoyance.
"What the hell, Ancestor?" she said, "I was not done! You can't just give someone a taste of Infinite Primus Mana and then cut them off mid-connection! That's cruel!"
Noah shook his head with amusement.
"You can have more later," he said calmly. "We have a guest."
A guest.
As he spoke those words, a vibrant voice rang out from above the now-dimming blue-gold singularity.
"Outsider, what crazy thing have you done? I didn't expect your little project in the Earliest Folds to lead to this..."
The voice of Khor echoed across the sky as her small figure descended...ancient despite her youthful appearance, her crimson
eyes shining with hunger.
Her dark hair seemed to naturally drink in all surrounding light, creating subtle shadow wherever she moved.
She had brought part of her consciousness with Noah when he'd ventured into the Earliest Folds, witnessing everything he'd seen...including the founding of the Isolated Civilization.
He'd called her here now because after exceeding 20 Quintillion Complexity and Purity, he could finally utilize the Existential Rollback feature of The Principle of Cheating Architect.
He could restore lost weavings or previous states of existence.
And Khor...who had once been an entity carrying the distinction of THE before catastrophic loss reduced her, represented a prime candidate for explosive power recovery, alongside potential
restoration of her sealed memories.
Noah looked up toward her as Riya peeked around his shoulder with curious assessment.
"Really, Little Ancestor?" Riya said, pouting.

"You were just about to get some, and you sabotage yourself by bringing a sweet old lady here? Who is she? I can sense endless Hunger radiating from her existence...feels dangerous but also... diminished?"
Sweet old lady.
Khor blinked at the description, then smiled with sharp amusement.
"Sweet old lady?" she repeated, her voice carrying dangerous humor. "Tiny Thing, I was devouring Civilizations before your ancestors figured out how Mana worked."
Her crimson eyes swept across Riya's form with assessment.
"Outsider, I've seen you with women possessing far fuller proportions...you call them curvaceous, right? Why did you go for this tiny thing? I can't find any curves on her."
BOOM!
Riya's smile transformed into something dangerous.
"You...you old thing!" she countered, "Have you seen yourself?!"
The two locked gazes, and Noah could sense they would continue escalating if left unchecked.
He stepped between them, his presence commanding enough to pause everything.
"Enough," he said calmly, looking at Khor with focused intent.

"I may be capable of restoring a portion of your power...potentially significant portions. That's why I brought you here to this Isolated. Civilization. Concentrated energy for your Hunger to feast upon. Resources accumulated over nearly millions of years."
His expression hardened.
"And I'm doing this with speed because I don't like how even now,
after everything I've accomplished, nothing has seemingly changed.THE Dead Order continues advancing, one of her Guiders of
Order already exceeds 100 Quintillion, and that's likely just the
beginning of their power!"
His eyes flashed with chilling light.
"We need more information and power. And what better source than
someone who used to hold THE distinction? Someone who's seen
how beings at that level operate, who understands their capabilities
and limitations?"
When he spoke such words, Khor's smile widened, genuine interest replacing her earlier mockery.
Behind Noah, Riya peeked out with suddenly fascinated eyes at the mention of someone who used to hold THE distinction.
She actually carried THE distinction? Riya's mind raced. And lost it
somehow...?
"Well then, Outsider," Khor said. "Lets see just how far your Way has
come."
Her crimson eyes blazed.
"Show me this...restoration."
Noah's tyrannical heart pulsed with determination and unfathomable
glory!
Time to see if The Cheating Architect could allow for even grander
impossibilities!
Time to add one more impossible accomplishment to his growing list of violations against predetermined limitations!

chapters.title: Chapter 4394 The Doctrines of Hunger I
paragraphs: Noah floated toward Khor, his form radiating blue-gold brilliance from the Primus Mana coursing through his existence.
Behind him, Riya watched with fascinated eyes as the singularity above continued dimming.
Noah could also sense the signatures of brilliant concentrations of Mana heading in this direction, with these belonging to the Seed Members of this Civilization.
"Are you ready?" He asked.
Khor's crimson eyes met his with ancient hunger perfectly contained beneath their surface.
"Outsider, it is just power. I had it once. I may have it again. Let us see what the results will be."
Noah gazed at this unique being calmly as he closed the remaining distance between them.
"Existential Rollback," he said simply.
HUUM!
Existential Rollback Protocol Initiated
Function: Restore lost weavings or previous states of existence for designated target
Resource Requirement: 50 Mana Glyphs of The Cheating Architect (Active Consumption)|
Current Available: 125 Mana Glyphs - Sufficient for activation|
CRITICAL NOTE: Primus Mana elevation detected in all active reserves
Effect: Unknown enhancement to restoration parameters]
Projected Outcome: Standard rollback would restore partial power/ state
Enhanced Outcome: Primus-elevated rollback may achieve results exceeding theoretical maximums
WARNING: Target's lost state involves THE distinction - restoration may have cascading unknown existential effects. Restoration to THE is entirely out of the realms of possibility.
Proceeding with activation...
Golden light erupted around Noah's form...the pure crystalline gold of the fundamental architecture of Cheating Architect asserting itself.
Riya watched with wonder as Noah's hand rose slowly, his five fingers extending toward Khor's face with deliberate precision.
Contact.
The moment his fingertips touched her skin, a blinding pillar of golden light erupted skyward with force that painted the entire Isolated Civilization in radiance of magisterial gold.
Riya's jewel-blue eyes tracked the phenomenon with fascination mixed with concern.

When she looked at Noah and Khor directly, she saw both of their eyes shining with pure golden beams of light, their expressions calm as if they were no longer present in their bodies...as if consciousness had departed for somewhere else entirely.
Noah did not fully know where he was at this moment.
He felt like a grand observer watching existence unfold in an extremely unique place...neither participant nor truly external, but something between.
A witness to history that had already occurred, viewing events through mechanisms that far, far exceeded normal temporal observation.
His gaze drank in surroundings.
Endlessly rising jagged obsidian towers stretched toward a sky.
Everything was immensely dark...filled with a concentration of darkness, as if shadow had been compressed until it became solid architecture.
And everywhere, absolutely everywhere, trillions of Inevitabilities swarmed.
They blotted out nearly every spot of atmosphere with their tentacle-formed bodies, creating a living sea of writhing obsidian appendages that moved with coordinated purpose.
His perception focused on the top of one flat obsidian tower, and there he saw a figure who looked like Khor... but didn't show the ancientness of age in her eyes.
She seemed young.
Filled with a sense of innocence that the current Khor had long since
lost.
Her form was humanoid rather than her natural Inevitability shape, and she stood before another humanoid Inevitability who gazed at her
with eyes full of accumulated wisdom.
The humanoid Inevitability spoke first, his voice showing gentle
concern.
"What troubles you, Little Hunger?"
Young Khor's expression twisted with frustration and hurt.
"All the other Inevitabilities are bullying me," she said, "They mock
this form I'm taking. Say I'm pretending to be weak. But... She looked down at her humanoid hands with confusion.
"This form does limit my power. I can feel my Hunger constrained, compressed into something smaller than it should be. Why do I have to take this form? Why do you make me practice being weaker than I
am?"
The humanoid Inevitability, his features stern but kind, knelt to meet her gaze directly.
"Look around you, Little Hunger," he said, gesturing at the swirling mass of tentacle-formed Inevitabilities.
"Among all the trillions here, have you seen any others who can take
this form like us?"
Young Khor shook her head silently.

"The form we're inhabiting," he continued, "is the form of one of the weakest creatures in existence. Soft. Fragile. Limited in ways our natural state never experiences. But that is precisely why it's valuable
for training."
He placed a hand on her shoulder with gentleness.

"If you can learn to hone your Hunger in this form at your weakest, if you can master control when constrained, when limited, when operating at a fraction of your natural capability...then one day you may grow to be as strong as I am. Strength cultivated through constraint becomes far more refined than power that knows no limitation."
He straightened, his expression becoming more serious.
"Now, remember what I told you about the Doctrines of Hunger. What
was the first and foremost?"
The question carried weight of stern teacher testing crucial lessons.
Young Khor's expression shifted...frustration giving way to concentration as she accessed memorized teachings.
"The First Doctrine of Hunger," she recited, her voice steadying,

"states that Hunger is the fundamental acknowledgment of incompleteness. We hunger because we recognize we are not yet whole. We devour because we seek to become more than we currently are. All advancement begins with acknowledging what we lack, and all growth stems from the desire to fill that void. To deny Hunger is to deny the possibility of becoming greater."
WAA!
The humanoid Inevitability nodded with satisfaction.
"Correct. And because you acknowledge you lack control in this weak
form, you possess the foundation necessary to eventually transcend that weakness."
He offered his hand to lift her up, his smile carrying warmth.
"Come on. Existence has much more for you to see, and lessons don't
wait for readiness."
Young Khor took his hand, her expression brightening despite
lingering confusion.
"Yes, Tor."
Tor.
Noah observed the scene as his eyes flashed with analytical brilliance.
There was someone, an Inevitability, even more powerful than Khor? How did she become THE First Hunger and not him? What happened to change that hierarchy?

chapters.title: Chapter 4395 The Doctrines of Hunger II
paragraphs: As he contemplated this, the scene before him shifted.
He found himself observing a different location, a different moment in Khor's history.
This time she was helping an injured Tor inside a Nest of
Inevitabilities...a gathering place where their kind congregated for rest and communion.
Her young expression was fierce and livid with barely contained rage. "What did this to you?!" she demanded, "Who dared?!"
Tor smiled despite obvious pain, his form partially destabilized.
"You do not have to worry about that right now," he said with gentle deflection. "But tell me...what is the Second Doctrine of Hunger?"
Fighting back anger and pain, young Khor's voice steadied as she recited.

"The Second Doctrine of Hunger states that Hunger must remain carefree in its pursuit. To hunger with desperation is to corrupt the purity of desire. To devour with frantic need is to diminish what is consumed. We must approach all things with lightness, understanding that existence is vast and opportunities are endless. Anxiety about what we lack poisons our capability to appreciate what we gain. Be hungry, but be joyful in that hunger!"
Tor nodded with satisfaction despite his injuries.

"Exactly. So do not let concern for my matters weigh heavily upon you. I will recover or I won't...either outcome is simply another experience to devour. For Hunger needs to be carefree, even in the face of potential loss."
The scene dissolved before Noah's perception, existence shifting
once more.
He found himself observing a glorious sight.
Khor and Tor stood atop a crystalline obsidian cliff that overlooked vast territories. Trillions of powerful tentacle-formed Inevitabilities swirled around them in organized patterns.
They were paying respect- fealty, Noah's mind corrected, all of them bowing toward Tor with gestures that suggested absolute loyalty.
Young Khor looked at this scene with shining eyes full of wonder and aspiration.
"How did you do this?" she asked, genuine awe in her voice. "How did you gather so many to follow willingly? They want to serve you. What makes them choose this?"
Tor's expression showed satisfaction as he turned to face her.
"Tell me the Third Doctrine of Hunger."
With eyes blazing with understanding, Young Khor recited.

"The Third Doctrine of Hunger states that true Hunger establishes natural hierarchy. Those who hunger most powerfully, most purely, become inevitable leaders because others recognize something worth following. Leadership is not taken, it is devoured from the willing offering of those who see greater Hunger than their own and choose to feed it. We do not command; we simply hunger so magnificently that others cannot resist contributing to our consumption. Authority flows toward the hungriest as naturally as water flows downhill." Once she finished, Tor nodded with deep approval.

"One day, your mere presence will wash over Inevitabilities, and they will not be able to resist your leadership. Your Hunger will be so vast, so pure, that serving it will feel like privilege rather than obligation." The scene flickered, Noah's perception pulled forward through time
once more.
Now he focused on Khor...no longer quite so young, but not yet
ancient, standing defiantly against a hazy titanic creature radiating an air of ancientness and multicolored brilliance that made the
surrounding Inevitabilities flee in terror.
Khor looked at the entity coldly, her voice ringing with arrogant certainty.
"Your existence exists only to serve my Hunger! You are prey, and I am predator! Submit!"
She opened her mouth impossibly wide, her Hunger manifesting as physical force that tried to devour the titanic entity entirely.
But shockingly, that hazy creature raised one massive hand and brought it down with dismissiveness.
And Khor was horrified to feel the weight of all surrounding existence crashing down upon her.
Not just physical pressure...existential weight. Her own Hunger, her own Way of Hunger, was being used against her, forced to collapse inward and consume itself in catastrophic feedback loop!
She saw her collapse in that moment. Saw the end of everything she was becoming. Saw death in ways Inevitabilities rarely experienced.
But...
BOOM!
In the next moment, she opened her eyes fearfully to see Tor standing before her, smiling with familiar gentleness.
His back faced the titanic creature as he chided her with tone mixing disappointment and amusement.
"Little Hunger, how did you manage to provoke something at the level of THE? Do you have any sense of appropriate targets, or do you simply challenge everything that looks interesting?"
Khor was unable to answer, shock stealing her voice.
Tor's expression softened further.
"Close your eyes for a moment. Can you do that for me?"
Trembling, Young Khor closed her eyes.
Noah watched as the moment Khor's eyes shut, the vision flickered
and disappeared, simply vanishing as if existence itself had been
edited.
When the vision resumed, time unknown, could have been seconds or days, Khor opened her eyes to witness devastation.
All of existence around her was empty and decimated. Only collapse remained, vast territories reduced to void. The only intact structure was a single obsidian crystal platform where she stood.
And before her stood Tor once more, smiling... but half of his body
was missing.
Simply gone. Erased. The remaining half flickering with instability that
suggested imminent dissolution.
Khor trembled, tears streaming down her face.
Tor's half-visage remained calm, almost serene, as he spoke with
fading strength.
"What is the Ninth Doctrine of Hunger?"
Fighting back tears that threatened to overwhelm her voice, Khor
recited through sobs.
"The Ninth Doctrine of Hunger states that all that which is hungered

and devoured never leaves us, it only becomes part of us, part of The Way of Hunger. We are not diminished by consuming others; we are expanded. Every existence we devour adds their essence to our own. Every concept we hunger for and claim becomes woven into our nature. Nothing is truly lost in consumption- it is transformed, elevated, made eternal through integration with our Hunger. We carry
everything we've ever consumed as part of what we are."
HUUM!
At such words, Tor nodded with satisfaction despite his deteriorating
state. "Little Hunger," he said softly, "can you do me a favor? Can you... make me part of you? I am about to fade, and I don't want to disappear
forever. But you have the chance to keep me with you."
His expression carried plea mixed with absolute trust. "Just remember the Ninth Doctrine... and take a bite. Just a bite."
Just a bite.
Noah watched with astonishment as devastated Khor was urged by
Tor to hurry, his form becoming more translucent with each passing
moment.
She opened her mouth, tears still streaming, and took a bite!
And Tor disappeared.

And in the next moment, Khor's figure began radiating astonishing obsidian-crimson radiance that spread outward for countless distances, painting void-collapsed territories in her authority. Countless Inevitabilities began appearing, gathering, circling around
her with their tentacle forms and bowing.
Their sounds were mournful, as if they had just lost something they could never recover, as if acknowledging transition of leadership they both celebrated and grieved!

chapters.title: Chapter 4396 The Doctrines of Hunger III
paragraphs: Noah watched such a scene with profound understanding lighting his eyes.
Khor had inherited everything!
She consumed Tor completely and eventually became THE First Hunger through that act!
In the next moment...
CRACK!
The scene shattered entirely like glass struck with overwhelming force.
Noah found his eyes opening, consciousness returning to his body, gaze locking onto the current Khor floating above the Isolated Civilization.
Around them, the Mana had turned crimson-blue...his Primus Mana mixing with her resurgent Hunger.
Their eyes locked.
Khor smacked his hand away from her face with violent force, her crimson eyes blazing with rage!
HUUM!
"Why did you do that?!" she bellowed, her complexity seething!
"WHY?! I had forgotten! I had finally, after eons, managed to forget!" BOOM!
Her figure radiated terrifying power as pain flooded her expression, ancient grief mixing with resurgent loss!
Noah gazed at her with solemn eyes as prompts cascaded down.
Multiple existential seals binding target "Khor" have been broken
Primus Mana elevation induced quintessential restoration results exceeding projected parameters
Target's power currently increasing exponentially - quantification pending complete stabilization]
Emotional instability detected - psychological trauma from memory restoration may cause unpredictable behavior]
In the midst of cascading power, Khor's eyes retained their rage as she roared toward Noah.
"Why did you make me remember?! I had forgotten!"
BOOM!
Riya appeared beside Noah instantly, her expression stern as her jewel-blue eyes flashed with coldness and caution.
She assessed Khor with combat readiness, prepared to defend despite the growing and obvious power disparity.
Kael and dozens of other Seed Members at 50 Quintillion began manifesting behind them, their forms blazing!
And shockingly, these terrifically powerful beings felt oppression from Khor's resurgent presence....weight that suggested she was approaching and exceeding their collective capabilities.
At such a time, Noah looked at Khor with eyes carrying pity rather than fear.
"Tell me," he said quietly, "what is the Ninth Doctrine of Hunger?"
His words caused Khor's figure to tremble, rage faltering as her eyes filled with immense complexity.
The raging aura around her began calming...settling into something more controlled.

She looked upward, her gaze hazy as if seeking something distant she could no longer touch, as if Noah's figure overlapped with someone she had known a long, long time ago...and then she began speaking. "The Ninth Doctrine of Hunger states that all that which is hungered and devoured never leaves us. It only...becomes part of us. Part of The Way of Hunger. We carry everything we've consumed as part of what we are."
After she finished, Noah nodded with gentle understanding.

"Those who walk The Way of Hunger are never truly gone," he said softly. "They are part of you. Tor... is part of you. Has been, all this time. You didn't lose him...you carry him with every action, every thought, every expression of Hunger."
Khor's body trembled as she bit her lip, nodding slowly while closing
her eyes to center herself.
She took some more seconds.
And then...
"Thank you, Outsider, and apologies for the outburst..." she said silently.
She looked toward Noah, preparing to say more..
But at this moment, she saw that Noah wasn't even gazing at her
anymore.
His eyes were hazy, distant, as shockingly he was repeating the Doctrines of Hunger while looking upwards!
"All that which is hungered and devoured never leaves us..."
"Hunger is the fundamental acknowledgment of incompleteness..."
"Hunger must remain carefree in its pursuit..."
"True Hunger establishes natural hierarchy..."
Khor's eyes widened in shock as above Noah, a figure materialized.
Ozymandias.
Noah's other part of existence...paradoxically him and not him
simultaneously!
Ozymandias appeared as a humanoid mass of obsidian-gold tentacles.
And at this moment, he was reciting the same words as Noah in perfect synchrony, their voices overlapping as if single entity
speaking through two mouths.
Amidst this shocking development, as even Riya and the Seed Members observed with mounting unease, Noah, in his trance, saw glorious prompts materializing!
CRITICAL EXISTENTIAL ANOMALY DETECTED
An impossible and unfathomable possibility has bloomed]
A part of your existence that IS your existence and IS NOT your
existence has truly and completely embarked upon The Way of
Hunger
Your unified being is fragmenting into parallel developmental paths
You are attempting to pioneer TWO separate Ways of Existence
simultaneously:
-The Way of the Mana Architect (Primary, Established)|
-The Way of Hunger (Secondary, Emerging through Ozymandias)|
POTENTIAL OUTCOMES:
Success: Enact two separate Civilizations operating under unified consciousness
-Unprecedented in recorded existence
|-Would allow cultivation of complementary advancement paths
-Multiplicative power growth through dual framework development
Failure: If conviction to either Way proves insufficient, both Civilizations and Ways could collapse upon themselves
-Catastrophic existential dissolution
-Loss of all accumulated advancement
-Potential complete unmaking
CURRENT STATUS: Mutation in progress - outcome undetermined
Your existence is undergoing unknown changes.
BOOM!
Noah's form blazed with mixed radiance....blue-gold Primus Mana
warring with obsidian-crimson Hunger as his existence tried to accommodate both frameworks simultaneously!
And around him, his people watched with mounting concern as their
Architect attempted something that they did not fully understand!
Hi's body pulsed with rhythmic intensity that made the surrounding atmosphere tremble.
His existence was in a unique state of mind at this moment.
A liminal space where fundamental decisions about what he was were
being made!
Because at this moment, an immense conflict was unfolding within the deepest structures of his being.
THE Living Paradox had The Way of Paradox. The Civilization of
Paradox.
THE Living Emotive had The Way of Emotive. The Civilization of
Emotive.
All beings who carried THE distinction possessed singular Ways of Existence. Unified frameworks through which they interacted with reality, upon which they built their Civilizations.

THE Dead Order remained holding The Way of Order even in death...she hadn't switched to The Way of Death, couldn't switch, because THE distinction bound you to the path you'd perfected to reach that scale.
One existence. One Way. One Civilization. That was the established norm across all scales of power, the fundamental rule that even beings with THE respected!
But at this moment, Noah was doing the impossible.
And his existence could fracture from it!
Could dissolve into incompatible fragments that unmade everything
he'd built.
But... could it really?
My Mana is INDEFATIGABLE!
HUUM!
The declaration blazed through Noah's internal existence with
tyrannical certainty.
My Way of Mana is INFALLIBLE...it cannot be corrupted, cannot be diminished, cannot be destroyed by external or internal forces!
I possess INFINITE reserves. INFINITE capacity. INFINITE potential
for expansion!
Hunger...will simply be held alongside it because my Mana is BOUNDLESS! My Primus Mana is BOUNDLESS!
HUUM!
It can afford to contain- no, it WILL contain...a Second Way of
Existence!
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4397 The Doctrines of Hunger IV
paragraphs: As Noah bellowed such declarations into his own fundamental Existence, his eyes snapped open wide.
He gazed at Khor, who was watching him with mounting concern.
What she saw made her ancient composure falter as she knew about Ways of Existence a great deal. She knew about their critical
singularity!
At this moment...
One of Noah's eyes radiated blue-gold tendrils of light...Primus Mana given visual form, cascading from his pupil like liquid brilliance.
The other pulsed with crimson-obsidian light...Hunger manifesting as darkness that devoured surrounding illumination while somehow remaining visible.
Mana. Hunger.
Two fundamental forces operating through single existence, and somehow not destroying each other in the process.
At this moment, those impossible eyes locked onto Khor as Noah spoke.
And his voice...
Oh!
His voice boomed with unnatural depth and weight, as if it was emanating from a being that far exceeded everyone present.
Not louder, but heavier, carrying existential mass that made reality itself vibrate!
"Tell me of the Doctrines of Hunger I have not heard," he commanded, each word resonating across multiple dimensional frequencies.
"Tell me of the Fourth, Fifth, Sixth, Seventh, and Eighth Doctrines."
HUUM!
The declaration made the surrounding Mana and emerging Hunger ripple in immensity.
Khor looked at him with immense concern, her ancient eyes recognizing something profoundly dangerous in what he was attempting.
"Outsider," she said seriously, "are you sure of this? What you're attempting..."
She asked, but Noah only gazed at her calmly with his mismatched eyes...one Mana, one Hunger, and spoke again with that impossible depth.
"Tell me of the other Doctrines of Hunger."
The repetition carried finality that clearly stated he would not be dissuaded.
After such unwavering affirmation, Khor nodded slowly, recognizing stubborn determination that mirrored her own ancient nature.
She began to recite.

"The Fourth Doctrine of Hunger states that Hunger thrives on impossibilities. We do not hunger for what is easily obtained...such consumption provides no satisfaction. We hunger for what should be beyond our reach, for what reality claims we cannot devour. The more impossible the target, the more our Hunger sharpens. Impossibility is not barrier but invitation. When existence declares something cannot be consumed, Hunger hears only challenge."
Noah's existence buzzed with recognition as he nodded, understanding settling into his Existence!
Khor continued without pause.
"The Fifth Doctrine of Hunger states that Hunger enables infinite

growth. There is no ceiling to what can be consumed, no limit to how vast Hunger can become. Where other Ways encounter barriers and plateaus, Hunger simply devours those limitations and continues expanding. We grow not despite obstacles but through them, consuming every ceiling until nothing remains to constrain our appetite. Growth is not gradual, it is ravenous."
WAA!
Again Noah nodded, his mismatched eyes blazing brighter.

"The Sixth Doctrine of Hunger states that Hunger finds pleasure in consumption itself, not merely results. We do not devour solely for power gained, we devour because the act of consumption brings profound satisfaction. The journey of Hunger matters as much as the destination. Every bite, every absorption, every integration carries its own joy. This makes Hunger sustainable where pure ambition burns out."

Khor's voice gained intensity as she approached the final teachings. "The Seventh Doctrine of Hunger states that Hunger transforms everything it touches into itself. We do not simply accumulate, we convert. Everything consumed becomes Hunger, everything devoured adds to our nature rather than diluting it. A thousand different essences consumed do not create chaos but unified expansion. Through Hunger, diversity becomes singular magnificent appetite."
She paused before the penultimate doctrine, her crimson eyes meeting Noah's impossible gaze.

"The Eighth Doctrine of Hunger states that Hunger must be shared to reach ultimate heights. Solitary consumption creates powerful individuals, but shared Hunger creates Civilizations. When multiple beings hunger together, when appetites align and consumption becomes coordinated, the resulting force transcends individual capability. We do not compete for food, we feast together, and in that communion, become greater than any lone devourer could achieve."
BOOM!
After listening to each doctrine, Noah's existence processed and
integrated everything.
He closed his eyes, arms spreading wide as his body began gushing
even more concentrated waves of power.
Behind him, Ozymandias's figure manifested fully.
Their backs faced each other, two bodies sharing single
consciousness, and both began to spin.
Slowly at first, then accelerating, creating a vortex of mixed authorities that painted the sky in impossible colors.

The pressure Noah radiated was immense, the weight of someone forcing reality to accommodate what shouldn't be possible. His voice boomed out again with that heavy, multi-dimensional depth, his voice seeming soft as he affirmed what he said before.

"My Way of Mana is unbreakable. Infinite resources, endless refinement, systematic elevation...it cannot be diminished or destroyed. My Way of Hunger is inevitable. All things can be consumed, all limitations devoured, all growth enabled through appetite. These truths are...fundamental."
His spinning accelerated.
"So my Existence...will simply have to make way and accept it."
BOOM!
The declaration hit reality like hammer striking anvil, and existence
complied.
What the fuck else could it do?!
HUUM! Noah's body pulsed and radiated resplendent blue-gold brilliance...Primus Mana elevated to such concentration it became
nearly solid, painting half the sky in radiance that made observers
squint.

Simultaneously, Ozymandias's body blazed with obsidian-crimson Hunger...darkness that devoured light while somehow remaining visible, creating shadows that moved independently of their sources. The Isolated Civilization found its skies split down the middle...one half brilliant blue-gold, the other consuming crimson-black, with Noah's dual forms at the exact center creating boundary between
impossible forces.
Riya looked at Noah's two bodies with eyes shining with fascination, her own existence buzzing with advancement.
Her jewel-blue gaze tracked between his forms with analytical intensity, trying to comprehend what was happening at existential levels in ways others could not see.
But her eyes saw much, much more than others.
Khor maintained somber expression as she observed radiant light of Hunger wrapping around him...around part of him, at least.
Her ancient eyes recognized what this meant, what doors were opening, what impossibilities were being enacted.
At such a moment, in the midst of all this glorious phenomena...
Your Existence has made an irreversible declaration Successfully harmonizing and bearing the full weight of embarking on TWO WAYS OF EXISTENCE
Successfully establishing capability of forging TWO DISTINCT CIVILIZATIONS
Most existences struggle to pioneer even one Way
