He looked at Goliath closely, studying his physical manifestationwith enhanced perception.
The being was a burly, muscular figure despite adopting human form, with white hair dancing wildly around features that seemed more appropriate to ancient Beast than civilized humanoid.
His human configuration barely constrained something far more primal, and his eyes revealed serpentine white pupils that provided glimpse of his terrifying snake-like authentic form.
Noah stood before such formidable being and spoke with a voice carrying calm certainty.
"Goliath... and you are actually a Veiled Living Origin from a Collapsed Civilization?
THE Living Origin, that grand existence who embodied beginnings themselves, had its Civilization collapsed?"
BOOM!
He articulated such profound questions in utterly calm manner that it was disconcerting!
Goliath's heavy eyes opened wide with shock, and in the next moment, his sizable body erupted with terrifying waves of Complexity and Purity that exceeded most others present!
The Living Paradoxes positioned around him were blown backward in shock as the carefully maintained disguise shattered, revealing what Goliath truly was.
His visage radiated immense white light of Origin...not Paradox but the fundamental authority of beginning preceding all other principles!
His titanic figure blazing with 46 Quintillion Complexity and Purity threw down both hands like hammer punches descending toward Noah with force sufficient to crater multiple Folds!
Noah looked at these devastating punches approaching with calm.
He didn't raise hands to block or manifest protective authorities.
He simply stood there.
BZZT!
An invisible field of power buzzed around him, a manifestation of his Civilization's Foundation Palisades operating at conceptual level rather than physical structure.
The field flicked these heavy punches aside as if they were strikes from petulant child rather than being possessing 46 Quintillion in accumulated power.
Noah took single step forward, and glimpse of his Civilization's full weight imposed itself upon Goliath.
That crushing pressure, that authority of a unified framework versus scattered individual might...descended with inexorable force!
Goliath's expression became heavy as his existence trembled under tbe strain.
His form bent slightly beneath a weight that shouldn't be possible!
He looked coldly at Noah through serpentine eyes.
"Who are you, truly?
Not the surface identity you present, but your authentic nature and allegiance?"
Noah replied with a voice maintaining perfect calm.
"What I am not is some force affiliated with THE Loom.
I possess no connection to that domain or the Civilizations secured within its boundaries.
What I am... is someone profoundly interested in this concept of Collapsed Civilizations you represent."
His eyes gleamed with focus.
"THE Living Paradox and THE Living Emotive collapsed THE Living
Origin and multiple other Civilizations besides that?
And you represent surviving Members of these destroyed Civilizations?
Where
precisely have you all been hiding across the eons since that
catastrophe?"
Noah's words emerged with steady precision.
If Goliath existed among Living Existences while maintaining false identity, were there numerous others hidden throughout the
Transcendent Folds?
If many Remnants from Collapsed Civilizations survived, where would they cluster or conceal themselves most effectively?
His eyes brightened with sudden insight...perhaps the vast Wandering Territories themselves?
At this moment, Goliath's white eyes flashed with pure white light of Origin as he studied Noah comprehensively.
His heavy voice echoed with mixture of confusion and reluctant
fascination.
"You genuinely aren't affiliated with THE Loom... how is this possible?
I can sense unmistakable aura of an established Civilization surrounding your existence...yet what Civilization could that possibly be?
We haven't observed any genuine Civilizations rising across the
eons since the catastrophes..."
Noah's smile widened at these words.
"You haven't been observing carefully enough in recent days.
Come now, tell me regarding yourself and these Collapsed Civilizations.
Oh, and provide anything you can regarding Schrodinger...and where his other bodies might be concealed."
At mention of that name, Goliath frowned with evident confusion.
"Schrodinger?
Why would you concern yourself with him?
What relevance does he hold to current circumstances?"

Noah smiled with expression mixing calm and dark amusement as he breathed deeply...savoring air of the Sanctuary that felt cleaner now, as if The First Farmer's collapse had released accumulated stagnation.
He spoke calmly with words of glorious and unfathomable revalation!
"Because Schrodinger and all his various bodies serve as Vessels for THE Living Paradox...the fucker who has just recently made personal appearance outside THE Loom."
BOOM!
Goliath's eyes opened wide at this information, his serpentine pupils dilating with shock and approached existential horror!
The other Living Existences positioned nearby, those barely listening
while maintaining polite distance, felt their weavings buzzing as if they were hearing information far too grand for their existences to safely process.
THE Living Paradox?
Here?
What?!
Goliath's expression transformed from shock to stern determination as he voiced heavily.
"I must warn the other Remnants immediately.

If THE Living Paradox has begun manifesting at this time, if the timeline we expected before The Fallout has accelerated beyond our projections... we may have far less preparation time than anticipated before THE Loom erupts and The Fallout consumes everything"
His white light intensified as urgency replaced confusion!
Noah watched with bright eyes as it seemed Existence outside THE Loom...still had more surprises!
Collapsed Civilizations.
The phrase carried a unique weight beyond simple historical notation,
encompassing tragedy and occasional triumph.
Across existence's infinite expanse and temporal duration, countless
empires had risen to magnificent heights before succumbing to internal decay or external conquest.
Yet the nature of collapse was rarely absolute.
More often than not, those ostensibly destroyed retained remnants...
fragments of accumulated knowledge, survivors carrying cultural memory, artifacts preserving technological achievements.
These scattered pieces persisted like embers after conflagration, glowing faintly amid surrounding darkness.
Now, these remnants could manifest two fundamentally divergent outcomes.
Some amounted to nothing beyond nostalgic recollection...beings who remembered glory at civilization's peak while lacking capability or will to reconstruct what had been lost.
They became living museums, preserving history without advancing it, eventually fading into obscurity as even memories deteriorated
across generations.
But other remnants possessed such concentrated grandeur, such
distilled essence of what their civilization had represented, that they succeeded in reforging collapsed frameworks!
Oh!
Rebuilding from ruin.
Establishing new foundations upon bedrock of
old principles refined through catastrophic failure.
Rarely.
For it was unfathomably difficult to restore that which had been
shattered...like attempting to reassemble a shattered mirror and expecting reflection to emerge flawless rather than distorted by innumerable fracture lines.
The weight of prior failure, the trauma of collapse, the scattered
nature of surviving resources... all conspired against successful resurrection.
Yet occasionally, against impossible odds, remnants succeeded in becoming phoenix rather than monument.
Those rare instances when broken became whole again represented
triumphs worthy of eternal commemoration.
At this moment.
On the other side of The Veil, in territories designated as The Lands
of The Dead.
A vast expanse stretched in all directions, filled with brilliance of
Order and Death intermingling.
There was white radiance suggesting absolute structure coexisting with obsidian luminescence suggesting inevitable cessation.
The combination created an atmosphere simultaneously peaceful and oppressive, suggesting finality accepted rather than resisted!
At the center of this impossible domain, a woman adorned in pristine
white dress examined her nds with deta
Their color appeared healthy and simultaneously not...a paradoxical
state.
If one observed her entire figure with enhanced perception, they

would witness her complete visage: fair skin shining like crystallized essence of graying-white purity, face holding immeasurable beauty refined beyond normal aesthetics into something approaching platonic ideal.
Her hair shifted constantly between obsidian darkness and brilliant
white, never settling upon single configuration...as if even basic characteristics couldn't decide between life and death, between what was and what had become.
But her eyes... her eyes held the grand weight of Civilization itself!
This...was THE Dead Order!

chapters.title: Chapter 4418 Collapsed Civilizations II
paragraphs: THE Dead Order.
She could effectively be considered the Leader of The First Collapsed Civilization to fall under hands of THE Living Paradox.
As she continued examining herself with an expression of satisfaction and lingering uncertainty, she spoke.

"I did not anticipate sensing the vileness of THE Living Paradox manifesting on the other side of The Veil. Not so... precipitously. Not before even I possessed capability to traverse that boundary and establish presence among the Living territories."
HUUM!
Her words catalyzed heavy reaction throughout surrounding expanse as dozens of nearby figures rose with synchronized fervor.
Each entity emanated staggering concentrations of power...some exceeding 100 Quintillion, others reaching 200 Quintillion, a select few approaching 300 Quintillion in Complexity and Purity.
They had been refined through her implementation of True Order, systematically elevated beyond what scattered cultivation would have achieved.
Several voices echoed with passionate conviction.
"O Order, permit us to embark on your behalf and pursue justice for transgressions inflicted upon you!"
"Grant us honor of confronting that entity which collapsed our original framework!"
"We shall demonstrate how Death refined through Order surpasses Living existence corrupted through Paradox!"
WAA!
"Justice?"
THE Dead Order smiled at such proclamations.
Her eyes flashed with immense hatred carefully cultivated and preserved across eons...annemotion refined into a weapon rather than allowed to remain chaotic passion.
She spoke with a voice maintaining perfect calm despite volcanic fury beneath surface composure.

"I have been wishing for justice across countless eons, and it has perpetually evaded my grasp. That entity possesses advantages I cannot currently match through direct confrontation...civilizational supremacy that would crush our forces regardless of numerical superiority or individual excellence."
Her gaze swept across assembled Guiders of Order.

"At our current developmental level, we are not yet adequately prepared for final confrontation. My intention was to continue establishing True Order across entirety of The Lands of The Dead, nurturing you systematically until achieving thresholds of 1,000 Quintillion or beyond before deploying forces against external targets."
She paused, allowing weight of that timeline to settle.

"But since the vile brilliance of THE Living Paradox has appeared and subsequently disappeared within the Lands of The Living... I must modify strategic planning. I will deploy a select contingent prematurely to investigate what transpired, to gather intelligence regarding his manifestation outside THE Loom's secured boundaries."
The moment she articulated this modification, multiple Guiders of Order rose with expressions mixing honor and determination at being selected for critical reconnaissance.
Forgemaster Vulcan, that imposing figure radiating concentrated authority, stepped forward at the forefront!
"O Great Mistress of Order, allow me the profound honor of moving on your behalf..."

Others rose with their own immaculate vows, each proclaiming dedication to establishing Order on her behalf while discovering what circumstances had permitted THE Living Paradox's temporary manifestation.
"My existence is yours to deploy, O Order! Direct me as instrument of your will!"
"I shall uncover truth regardless of resistance encountered, bringing intelligence worthy of your glorious brilliance!"
"Grant me this opportunity to demonstrate devotion refined through your elevation!"
Oh!
The gorgeous figure of THE Dead Order smiled with an expression of satisfaction mixed with broader vision extending beyond immediate
concerns.
She looked upward toward something that only she could perceive...perhaps viewing The Veil's structure itself, perhaps observing patterns invisible to subordinates despite their
considerable power.
When she spoke again, her voice held the glorious weight of revelation.

"You must understand fundamental truth: The Lands of The Dead are vaster than The Lands of The Living by orders of magnitude that defy easy quantification. All those entities that have perished across eons of existence... they reside here. Every collapse, every termination, every cessation feeds this domain."
Her eyes gleamed with anticipation of long-delayed plans finally reaching fruition.

"Collapsed Civilizations exist here...scattered remnants maintaining vestigial identities, preserving memories of former glory while lacking unified purpose or coordinated advancement. They will remain veiled and isolated no longer. We will leave them fragmented and directionless no longer."
She raised one hand with gesture carrying absolute authority.

"Some among you shall venture into the Lands of The Living to investigate what has occurred regarding THE Living Paradox's manifestation. At the same time, The Young Living Order and this...Osmont. Gather intelligence. Return with actionable understanding that will inform our eventual confrontation."
Her voice intensified.
"While the rest of you... shall spread systematically to all corners of

The Lands of The Dead and impose True Order without exception. All remnants of Collapsed Civilizations...those fragmented survivors maintaining separate identities, shall be unified under singular framework. The only Civilization permitted to exist across all territories outside THE Loom... shall be Order itself."
Her final words carried finality!
"There will be no competing frameworks. No alternative philosophies.
No scattered authorities pursuing divergent objectives."
Her eyes blazed with white brilliance of absolute conviction!
"There will only be... Order."
BOOM!
Brilliant white light of Order pulsed outward like incandescent sun achieving glorious ascension, washing across The Lands of The Dead with authority that could not be denied or resisted!
Oh!
The assembled Guiders of Order bowed in synchronized acknowledgment before dispersing to execute directives that would
reshape existence outside THE Loom.

Some would cross The Veil and investigate Living territories where The Young Living Order and THE Living Paradox had manifested. Others would spread throughout vast expanse of The Lands of The Dead, systematically locating and assimilating remnants of Collapsed Civilizations who had maintained fragmented existence for eons. All would serve singular purpose...establishing True Order as the only legitimate framework operating beyond THE Loom's boundaries. THE Dead Order remained in position after they departed, gaze still fixed on something invisible to others.
Perhaps she was calculating timelines until The Fallout. Perhaps she was contemplating strategies for eventual confrontation with THE Living Paradox, or the one known as Osmont.
Perhaps she was simply savoring the approaching culmination of
eons-long preparation!
Her smile showed anticipation mixed with carefully controlled hatred,
and her eyes held certainty that whatever setbacks had occurred in distant past, whatever catastrophes had transformed her from Living to Dead...
This time would be different.
This time, Order would triumph over Paradox.
This time, the scattered remnants would become a unified Civilization
capable of challenging even those secured within THE Loom!
The very essence of existence, the wind across The Lands of The Dead carried her conviction throughout the domain.
And everywhere it touched, Order intensified its grip..systematically transforming chaos into structure, converting scattered elements into coordinated whole.
The Remnants would be found and unified.
And when they did, existence outside THE Loom would know only
one authority.
Order. Absolute and Indefatigable!

chapters.title: Chapter 4419 You Hold My Everything I
paragraphs: Noah stood within the Early Veiled Shore, observing a select assembly of beings fortunate enough to be among the eighty-one recipients designated to receive the Boon of The Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades.

The atmosphere hummed with concentrated authority as bodies pulsed with newly integrated brilliance, systems of existences adjusting to sudden influxes of civilizational protection and raw Complexity and Purity!
Heidrun stood tall in a field of verdant-gold grasses, her magnificent goat form bellowing joyously as the transformation completed.

She was completely unaware that the diligent Malphas in his immaculate butler attire had already positioned himself nearby with pristine bucket, prepared to commence collection of the glorious Sacred Mead of Existence the moment her elevation stabilized sufficiently.
She would be put to work!
Yoshinami occupied a corner of the Early Veiled Shore in her spider form, her numerous terrifying crimson eyes shining with predatory light of hunger barely restrained.
Even though she currently held an excess of 25 Quintillion
Complexity and Purity due to the Palisades boon, her unique nature meant she could likely terminate a creature possessing 100 Quintillion!
Noah observed all this with satisfaction as beside him stood Khor's primary manifestation, The First Hunger herself, recently elevated through multiple cascading advancements.
He turned his gaze upon her specifically, clearly perceiving the mark of the Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades adorning her existence.
The mark manifested as an illusory blue-gold crown formed from the

architectural structure of palisades themselves, floating above her head with gentle rotation...neither physical nor purely conceptual, but something between, visible only to those with sufficient perception.
While standing beside him, Khor spoke.
"How do you wish to approach that Citadel of Justiciars? The one I observed containing the doorway to THE Loom?"

At this inquiry, Noah contemplated the information he had accumulated from Khor regarding The Living Emotives piloting those Justiciars, the horrifying wall of Mutated Inevitabilities that should theoretically connect to THE Loom's infrastructure, and the faint doorway inscribed upon that terrible structure.
Thinking specifically about the conversation between Living Emotives that Khor had witnessed and transmitted, Noah asked with smile mixing amusement and cynicism.

"What do you genuinely think of their proclamations that they were promised entry into THE Loom after accomplishing their assigned mission? My Primus Mana and instincts both insist it's utter fabrication..."

"That THE Living Emotive promised them this reward and maintained their hope across eons purely to extinguish it for perverse entertainment at conclusion. That even if we assault that location and attempt passage through that faint doorway, we may discover it leads precisely... nowhere."
He articulated such heavy implications with a casual tone!
And Khor remained silent briefly before sighing with sound mixing weariness and contained rage.
"Outsider, I simply want you to promise me something," she said.
"If we genuinely obtain opportunity to make THE Living Paradox and
his collaborators pay for their crimes... you allow me sufficient time to torture him and THE Living Emotive as extensively as they have been torturing the Inevitabilities across eons."
WAA!
Noah nodded calmly at these words, understanding the need underlying them.
"Here's to us actually reaching the point of possessing capability to stand against those psychopathic beings. When that moment arrives, your request will happily be honored"
Khor nodded with gratitude before turning her attention toward the Nest area populated by Inevitabilities within this Early Veiled Shore.
Her gaze locked specifically onto the visage of Bob...positioned centrally within the crystalline obsidian structure, surrounded by other Inevitabilities investigating him with cautious curiosity.
She addressed Noah without shifting her focus.

"That Little Bobby has become completely fused with the unfortunate Mutated Inevitability I've been attempting to restore. I've only succeeded in stabilizing the union between them thus far, and I've made modest progress in systematically stripping away whatever mutational corruption was forcibly imposed."
"However, I require it to become somewhat stronger to continue procedures with optimal efficiency. Could you grant Little Bobby the
Palisades boon?"

Khor asked such a question while Noah observed Bob...who was surveying surrounding Inevitabilities with expression mixing confusion and resignation, while his daughter stood beside Henry with visibly worried demeanor.
Noah shook his head with smile of amusement as he contemplated how Bob continuously received substantial power ups while
bypassing countless others simply due to circumstances he stumbled
into.
This entity genuinely demonstrated increasing resemblance to
archetypal protagonist...a ridiculous cockroach that never perished, accumulating boons seemingly by accident while others struggled deliberately for incremental advancement.
But even recognizing this pattern, Noah made the selection to include
Bob among the eighty-one slots.
HUUM!
In the next moment, brilliant blue-gold radiance descended upon
Bob's form.
The Mark of The Palisades materialized above his head like ethereal
crown, and his Complexity and Purity, alongside that of the Mutated Inevitability fused with him, began surging explosively toward 25
Quintillion threshold.
Khor smiled.
"Thank you, Outsider. Let me know when we prepare to strike that
Justiciar Outpost."
She proceeded to move toward Bob and the assembled Inevitabilities, already contemplating procedures to completely separate or restore! Noah observed this calmly, his mind cataloguing extensive tasks
demanding attention.
And there were many!
Attacking that Justiciar Outpost to investigate the doorway and assess
whether it genuinely connected to THE Loom or represented
elaborate deception.
After sufficient preparation, raiding the Desiccated Sleeping Shore that Riya had extracted intelligence about from Leonore Rureaux, plus other potential locations concealing Schrodinger's vessels.
And additionally, there existed the newly revealed grandeur of
Collapsed Civilizations, with Goliath serving as key to understanding that entire hidden ecosystem.
"Light work... light work!" Noah muttered with eyes vibrant with
anticipation.

Even though the accumulated tasks appeared overwhelming when itemized, all of it would continue facilitating growth of his Civilization...each challenge overcome translating into advancement that elevated entire framework simultaneously!
As he contemplated this, his surroundings *
buzzed with unusual intensity as his existence felt even grander immensity settling across his fundamental structures.
He traced the cause to his Foundation Palisades...within the manifestation of his Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger, they were growing taller and more elaborate once more, and because they
advanced...
His Complexity and Purity, his Glyphs, Towers, Atlas, Haki, all integrated components of his existence collectively elevated in
synchronized harmony!
The reason being....
Prompts bloomed with their ceremonial weight.
The Harvest of Collapse from The Death of The First Farmer has been
fully incorporated into the civilizational framework PROTECTION THRESHOLD INCREASED:
Previous: 200 Quintillion Complexity and Purity required to harm
your existence
Current: 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity required to harm
your existence
Your own Complexity and Purity has broken past 150 Quintillion
threshold
All integrated systems elevated proportionally
BOON ENHANCEMENT:
Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades empowerment increased from 25
Quintillion to 35 Quintillion Complexity and Purity
All currently selected recipients will experience synchronized
elevation HUUM!

After sufficient preparation, raiding the Desiccated Sleeping Shore that Riya had extracted intelligence about from Leonore Rureaux, plus other potential locations concealing Schrodinger's vessels.
And additionally, there existed the newly revealed grandeur of
Collapsed Civilizations, with Goliath serving as key to understanding that entire hidden ecosystem.
"Light work... light work!" Noah muttered with eyes vibrant with
anticipation.

Even though the accumulated tasks appeared overwhelming when itemized, all of it would continue facilitating growth of his Civilization...each challenge overcome translating into advancement that elevated entire framework simultaneously!
As he contemplated this, his surroundings *
buzzed with unusual intensity as his existence felt even grander immensity settling across his fundamental structures.
He traced the cause to his Foundation Palisades...within the manifestation of his Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger, they were growing taller and more elaborate once more, and because they
advanced...
His Complexity and Purity, his Glyphs, Towers, Atlas, Haki, all integrated components of his existence collectively elevated in
synchronized harmony!
The reason being....
Prompts bloomed with their ceremonial weight.
The Harvest of Collapse from The Death of The First Farmer has been
fully incorporated into the civilizational framework PROTECTION THRESHOLD INCREASED:
Previous: 200 Quintillion Complexity and Purity required to harm
your existence
Current: 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity required to harm
your existence
Your own Complexity and Purity has broken past 150 Quintillion
threshold
All integrated systems elevated proportionally
BOON ENHANCEMENT:
Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades empowerment increased from 25
Quintillion to 35 Quintillion Complexity and Purity
All currently selected recipients will experience synchronized
elevation HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4420 You Hold My Everything II
paragraphs: The advancement from The First Farmer's accumulated efforts fully distributed across his Civilization's architecture, demonstrating how even tragic conclusions could fuel future growth.
Now, for any entity to even contemplate penetrating his defenses, they required an excess of 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity, and membership in established Civilization.
They were dual prerequisites that eliminated vast majority of potential threats!
He was growing steadily, systematically, and building foundations that would support eventual confrontation with THE entities themselves.
He continued deliberately avoiding comparison with others regarding progression velocity, because...

"Comparison is the thief of joy, and in my case, probably also the thief of sanity. If I spent time measuring my advancement against beings like THE Living Paradox who have cultivated across eons, I'd either develop crippling inadequacy complex or dangerously inflated ego depending on how I chose to rationalize the disparity...and my ego is not that big, is it...?"
He smiled calmly.
It was better to focus on his own glorious trajectory, celebrate the incremental victories, and acknowledge that the only meaningful competition is against his previous self!

He smiled at his own philosophical meandering as he also considered the boons of The Primus Mana Glyphs of Perpetual Harvest...two hundred Glyphs that could each grant 1 Quintillion Complexity and Purity for the next 24 hours.
That represented total of 200 Quintillion waiting to be distributed!
His initial instinct was consuming all empowerment personally, but... he wanted to test something specific. And the subject of this experiment was The Living Order herself...Sigrid!
He walked across golden sands toward The Abode of the Early Creature where Sigrid currently resided.
The Abode that now contained countless pocket dimensions where Barbatos, Adelaide, Athena, and other members of his modest harem were...cultivating in various forms.
After all, in existence, there existed different methodologies of advancement!
Inside The Abode of The Early Creature, Osmont.

Though it appeared as grand tribal building outwardly on the Early Veiled Shore, internally it stretched into blue-gold stellar hall surrounded by numerous doors leading to different pocket dimensions...each one customized for specific purposes or residents.
At this time, within one particular pocket dimension.
The space shone with white and blue radiance as rivers of pure Order intermixed with currents of blue Mana in complex patterns.

Apart from the radiant sea below, there existed reflecting sea above, and suspended between them were stellar white rivers moving with absolute precision...each droplet following trajectory ordained by Order.
On the golden sands of this place reclined the primary body of Sigrid, adorned in loose damp white robe that clung to her curvaceous figure.
Her dark-and-white hair shone with radiant glow, wet and hanging over shoulders and across robe in a gorgeous artistic disarray.

The Mark of The Palisades floated above her head like ethereal crown, making her entire figure appear even more radiant...like a radiant fairy from ancient times contemplating mysteries in sacred space!
At this moment, Noah materialized and sat beside her on the sandy beach, breathing deeply of potent atmosphere saturated with Mana and Order while asking casually.
"What's occupying your thoughts?"
She replied while leaning her shoulder against him, her head tilting to rest upon his shoulder.

"I am contemplating my place in all this. Whether I am merely bringing trouble through my connection to Order, or if I will accomplish something genuinely significant with it. Burden or asset. Problem or solution."
Trouble, or something significant.
At such words, Noah smiled and looked out at the brilliance of Mana
all around them.
"Why not both? Most truly interesting things in existence manage to be simultaneously problematic and invaluable. And I can't get enough of trouble."
As soon as he articulated such words, radiant green-gold rivers of light began descending from above...a manifestation of Perpetual Harvest's accumulated empowerment.
They crashed onto Sigrid's figure with concentrated force, and with each blast of brilliance she absorbed, she felt her power explode
upward by full 1 Quintillion!
She looked toward Noah with dazzling eyes.
"What is this?"
It constituted stupendous sensation as beside her, Noah simply
smiled.

"Just some empowerment stemming from efforts of failure...The First Farmer's accumulated harvest transformed into elevation. I have been reaching significant milestones recently and I want to observe if something notable occurs when you achieve a sufficiently profound threshold of your own."
Sigrid trembled at his words.
This entire time, he had been giving and giving everything to her without expectation of reciprocation or demand for equivalent
exchange.
Resources, protection, opportunities, affection...lots of affection, and
just...everything.
She desperately wanted to provide something substantial in return!
To produce tangible results worthy of his investment.
Sigrid bit her lip as her hand found Noah's strong hand, her fingers intertwining with his.
When she spoke, her voice emerged with intensity.

"I will not claim to comprehend all intricacies of existence. I will not pretend to understand how existential forces truly operate at fundamental levels. But... you must understand one thing. And that is...you hold My Everything. Not metaphorically. Not an exaggeration.
You possess the entirety of what I am and what I might become. My Order. My essence. My potential. My heart. My Everything... It is all
yours."

A blinding light of Order pulsed at such declaration, and Noah looked toward Sigrid with somber recognition of what she was truly offering. Empowerments continued descending upon her as she maintained unwavering gaze, eyes set with determination!
Prompts materialized at this moment!
The Resurgence of THE Living Order, a critical component of a once-grand Civilization, has completely given itself to you and your
Civilization
PERMANENT CONSEQUENCE:
The Civilization of Order has forever lost opportunity to be restored
as independent Civilization However, it possesses potential to rise from ashes as something grander through integration with your Primordial Civilization of Mana
and Hunger
Order can thrive through Mana and Hunger as symbiotic rather than
competing principles
FUTURE BENEFITS:|
After reaching significant developmental milestones, Past Features of
The Civilization of Order will be permitted to bloom within your
Civilization
Access to refined authorities, architectural principles, and strategic capabilities accumulated across Order's existence will become
available
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4421 Siphoning! I
paragraphs: Noah's eyes shone brilliantly as he gazed at Sigrid.
"You didn't need to do that."
She smiled with an expression mixing serenity and fierce conviction.
"Please, I cannot provide you with much given my current state. Let me at least offer thi-"
BOOM!
Her words ceased abruptly as blinding white brilliance exceeding anything manifested previously erupted from her existence, forming a pillar that engulfed Noah as well in concentrated radiance!
This occurred precisely after a light of Empowerment descended that allowed her Complexity and Purity to exceed 100 Quintillion
threshold...apparently triggering something far more significant than a simple numerical milestone.
New prompts bloomed.
A significant existential threshold has been surpassed by The Resurgence of THE Living Order
This threshold permits The Resurgence to begin receiving full inheritance of the Collapsed Civilization of Order
CIVILIZATIONAL AUTHORITY OF ORDER - TRANSFER INITIATED
The Resurgence of THE Living Order has begun siphoning and drawing from the Civilizational Authority and accumulated Complexity and Purity of the Collapsed Civilization of Order]
At its core, Order aligns with The Living rather than The Dead Therefore, The Resurgence of THE Living Order holds higher commandment over Order than THE Dead Order]
CONSEQUENCE:|
An Unbreakable Link has been formed from The Resurgence of THE Living Order to THE Dead Order]
The gradual transference of The Civilizational Authority of Order has commenced
This process cannot be prevented, reversed, or interrupted through any known mechanism
BOOM!

As Noah processed these revelations, his perception shifted dramatically...finding illusory versions of himself and Sigrid floating in vast expanse of white and black brilliance that seemed to exist outside normal dimensional constraints.
Before them stretched a transparent veil...a glorious boundary between Living and Dead territories manifested at conceptual level. And past this veil...
There existed an illusory image of a massive entity hundreds of times larger than their projected forms.
Noah looked at this being and instantly understood!
This was THE Dead Order herself, manifested at scale suggesting her true civilizational weight rather than individual power.
Her regal, otherworldly beauty transcended many things!
Hair shifting between darkness and white with each breath. Eyes holding accumulated authority of an entire Civilization refined across eons!
Oh!
At this moment, her expression showed utter shock...composure that

had likely remained unshaken across countless catastrophes now fractured by something she clearly hadn't anticipated or prepared for. Because from her existence, a steady stream of white Order was beginning to flow inexorably toward Sigrid!
Not violently extracted but drawn, as if something in Sigrid's nature possessed stronger claim to Order's fundamental essence than THE Dead Order's painstakingly reconstructed authority.
Oh!
Oh!!!
The implications settled with devastating finality as THE Dead Order's eyes widened with recognition of what was occurring, and the
absolute impossibility of preventing it!
Noah's eyes shone with luminous brightness as he analyzed the entire situation millions of times across nanoseconds.
Before him, he witnessed the initial shocked expression of THE Dead Order fade with remarkable swiftness, replaced by immense calmness that settled across her features like mask precisely fitted.
Her regal composure returned as if the momentary fracture had never occurred, though the steady stream of white Order flowing from her existence toward Sigrid continued unabated.
She raised her massive hand to touch the river of white Order, fingers tracing the current as if attempting to comprehend a mechanism
through physical contact.
Then she looked at Sigrid and Noah with eyes of such profound calm that it bordered on unnatural.
Her gaze swept across them before she raised that same hand. toward... the veil separating them.
The transparent boundary between Living and Dead territories...a conceptual barrier given visible form through their unprecedented connection.
Noah's expression became heavy as recognition crystallized regarding
what she was attempting.
He immediately floated forward to position himself directly between Sigrid and THE Dead Order's approaching hand, his body pulsing with concentrated weight of his Civilization!

He stood fearlessly before the coming hand of an existence possessing THE distinction, refusing to yield ground despite the overwhelming disparity in accumulated power and refined authority! When THE Dead Order's hand neared the veil, reality itself seemed to
resist.
The space around her fingers distorted with strain as if existence was struggling to reconcile her attempt to cross with fundamental
weavings prohibiting such transit.
It felt like an unsurpassable barrier, an absolute prohibition!
As if it truly represented The Veil between The Living and The Dead, and THE Dead Order... could not cross.
Her hand pressed against invisible resistance, fingers splaying as concentrated force attempted to penetrate boundary that refused
penetration.
White brilliance of Order erupted around contact point, but the veil remained absolutely intact...unmoved by pressure that could reshape territories if directed elsewhere!
Noah's eyes flashed sharply as hypothesis was confirmed through
direct observation.
She genuinely could not cross!
He floated forward with deliberate motion, approaching the veil with
confidence.
When he reached the transparent boundary, he placed his own hand
against its surface adjacent to where THE Dead Order's massive
fingers pressed from the opposite side.
He performed a theatrical gesture of also attempting to push through...acting as if he encountered identical resistance, as if the barrier was equally impassable from his direction.
But internally... he felt no resistance wh
ver.
His hand could slide through the veil as easily as passing through
water, could traverse to the other side if he wished to make that
crossing.
But THE Dead Order did not need to know this particular truth.
Better to maintain impression of mutual constraint, of barrier that protected both sides equally.
He floated backward to resume position near Sigrid, and the two of them stared at the massive illusory manifestation of THE Dead Order while she stared back with gaze of utter calmness and regal
composure.
Even her eyes gave no indication of internal thoughts or emotional
state...a perfect mask maintained despite circumstances that should provoke significant reaction.
Her expression revealed absolutely nothing about how she was genuinely processing this unprecedented situation!
Noah observed this being while his existence attempted to calculate
countless variables simultaneously.
I barely encountered any entities at the level of THE across my
journey, and now I've confronted the Will of THE Living Paradox and THE Dead Order herself in the same fucking day. How ridiculously accelerated existence has become.
Throughout this charged silence, neither side spoke initially as Sigrid
displayed somber expression while feeling the continuous influx of The Civilizational Authority of Order.

chapters.title: Chapter 4422 Siphoning II
paragraphs: Her Complexity and Purity was jumping upward by multiple Quintillions with each passing moment!
And in this weighty silence, it was THE Dead Order who finally broke the stillness.
"The Resurgence of my Order..." Her gaze fixed on Sigrid with intensity.
"And I assume you are Osmont?" Her attention shifted to Noah. "You two are genuinely joined at the hip, it seems. How delightfully... intimate."
Her tone held no mockery despite the observation.
"You stand before the presence of Order itself. The Seer of Truth. The Arbiter of Structure. The First Foundation. The Architect of
Systematic Perfection." She paused deliberately.
"Though... you seem to be lapping up and siphoning modest portions of myself at this very moment through mechanisms I cannot immediately interrupt. Do you think you could stop that voluntary theft?"
Could she stop that.
At such a pointed question delivered with remarkable calm given circumstances, Sigrid remained initially silent.
She was uncertain how to respond to being directly addressed by the entity she was always dreading!
Noah looked at THE Dead Order with focus before proceeding to respond with his own formal introduction.
"You stand before the presence of The True Emperor of Quintessence. The True Emperor of Tyranny. The 9th Infernal Lord.
The Daemon of Tyranny. Imperius Avallonis. The Antediluvian. The Lumen Emperor. The Weaver of Existence. The Weaver of Extremity..."

The scene that unfolded carried mixture of grandeur and absurdity as...just as THE Dead Order had introduced herself through accumulated titles, Noah proceeded to do precisely the same but with far more exaggerated length.

He listed multiple grand designations with his voice maintaining perfect seriousness, his gaze remaining calm while THE Dead Order observed him with eyes beginning to shine with what might have been amusement beneath her careful composure.

"... The Gazer of the Unscalable Wall. The Indefatigable." He paused as if mentally cataloguing. "Let me see, is that everything? Ah, no. There are more. The Dreamer of Extremity. The Dream of The Beyonder. The Burnt One. The Cartographer of Existence. The Stranger. The Outsider..."
He let final titles settle with deliberate weight:
"The Early Creature, Osmont."
He had conducted such lengthy introduction that when he finally concluded, both Sigrid and THE Dead Order were regarding him with expressions mixing bewilderment and incredulity at the sheer
audacity of matching her formal presentation with such an
elaborately constructed response.
And in the silence following this performance, THE Dead Order spoke.
"You... are one of the primary reasons my Civilization is facing existential threat at this moment? You?"
The emphasis on that final word suggested difficulty reconciling the being before her...however unusual, with the scale of disruption
apparently being caused.
At such question, Noah nodded with perfect calm and utmost seriousness.
"Yes, Ma'am. And no, I don't believe The Resurgence of your Order, as you've termed her, I don't think she possesses capability to cease
siphoning from you. In fact..."
His smile widened slightly with an expression mixing tyrannical confidence and deliberate provocation.
"I think we'll amplify the process considerably."
BOOM!

An unfathomable phenomenon manifested as Noah and Sigrid came face to face with a terrifically powerful being possessing THE distinction...an entity who should theoretically be capable of collapsing them through mere attention!
And yet... neither side could harm the other!
Oh!
After Noah's bold proclamation, a heavy silence settled across the unique liminal space separating them from THE Dead Order.
The silence did not persist for an extended duration as Noah floated calmly through the conceptual space to more closely observe the river of white Order flowing steadily into Sigrid's existence.
The current maintained consistent velocity, neither accelerating nor diminishing despite the charged circumstances.
He turned to look deeply into Sigrid's eyes, searching for signs of strain or corruption, confirming she was managing the influx without
anything catastrophic.
She nodded with subtle gesture that conveyed reassurance.
Satisfied by this confirmation, Noah turned to directly face THE Dead Order's massive illusory form.
When he spoke again, his voice carried imposing calm as he began to bullshit.

"I have always felt profound sympathy for Order, truthfully. The first victim of THE Living Paradox's ambitions. Falling in a battle where you were only attempting to do what was fundamentally right. And what compensation did you receive for such righteous dedication? Collapse. Absolute termination."
His gaze intensified.
"Why did you have to be the one to perish? Why not Origin? Why not
Emotive? Why not Spirit or any of the other THE entities who participated in that conflict? And worst of all, after that grand show of force concluded, with THE Living Paradox being imprisoned
thereafter as a consequence... why was it that THE Living Emotive and others simply turned away and subsequently collaborated with THE Living Paradox to forge THE Loom?"
BOOM!
Noah's voice dropped with weight of an utterly damning assessment.

"It effectively rendered your sacrifice and death worth absolutely nothing. Your collapse became a meaningless footnote in a grand narrative rather than martyrdom that changed trajectories. You entire existence amouted to...absolutely... nothing."
BOOM!
His words landed with immense weight!
On the opposite side of The Veil, THE Dead Order received these observations with a calm smile!
"You say the truth with remarkable clarity, O True Emperor of Quintessence. My Collapse meant nothing in ultimate accounting. My sacrifice accomplished nothing beyond providing THE Living Paradox
with lesson about consequences...lesson he apparently learned well enough to avoid similar miscalculation subsequently."
Her expression shifted subtly.
"That...is precisely why Order remains so critically important. Had I

been present during THE Loom's construction, perhaps it would never have reached fruition. Perhaps if I possessed all my accumulated power at current developmental level, I could even prevent The Fallout entirely."
She leaned forward with interest intensifying.
"That is what you are attempting to accomplish, correct? You should

be systematically growing your budding Civilization because that represents the most straightforward pathway to attaining THE distinction. If you achieve THE, you possess genuine chance to survive The Fallout rather than becoming fuel for others' continuation."
Her smile took on dangerous edge as her massive face approached the
Veil more closely.
"But consider this alternative, 9th Infernal Lord, Imperius Avallonis,
The Antediluvian, The Lumen Emperor, The Weaver of Existence..."

She deliberately invoked multiple titles he had claimed. "I am positioned right here before you. I already possess THE distinction through refinement across eons. I simply require modest infusion of vitality to restore capabilities that were stripped during my collapse." Her eyes gleamed with a calculated offer.

"Can you provide that essential essence? Can you provide me with...her? I already carry THE distinction. With my counterpart currently drawing from my reserves, once we reunify and become one...that represents your optimal solution to The Fallout immediately available. I would then possess capability to rectify numerous wrongs, to restructure existence's trajectory. I could even share with you knowledge of the many alternative pathways to reach THE beyond
simple Civilization construction." She paused deliberately.
"Existence is vast beyond normal comprehension. Building a

Civilization constitutes the fastest and most straightforward methodology, certainly. But alternatives exist for those with sufficient intelligence and flexibility to pursue them. What do you say, Weaver
of Extremity? Dreamer of Extremity?"
BOOM!

sentences.text: Her Complexity and Purity was jumping upward by multiple Quintillions with each passing moment!
And in this weighty silence, it was THE Dead Order who finally broke the stillness.
"The Resurgence of my Order..." Her gaze fixed on Sigrid with intensity.
"And I assume you are Osmont?" Her attention shifted to Noah.
"You two are genuinely joined at the hip, it seems.
How delightfully... intimate."
Her tone held no mockery despite the observation.
"You stand before the presence of Order itself.
The Seer of Truth.
The Arbiter of Structure.
The First Foundation.
The Architect of
Systematic Perfection." She paused deliberately.
"Though... you seem to be lapping up and siphoning modest portions of myself at this very moment through mechanisms I cannot immediately interrupt.
Do you think you could stop that voluntary theft?"
Could she stop that.
At such a pointed question delivered with remarkable calm given circumstances, Sigrid remained initially silent.
She was uncertain how to respond to being directly addressed by the entity she was always dreading!
Noah looked at THE Dead Order with focus before proceeding to respond with his own formal introduction.
"You stand before the presence of The True Emperor of Quintessence.
The True Emperor of Tyranny.
The 9th Infernal Lord.
The Daemon of Tyranny.
Imperius Avallonis.
The Antediluvian.
The Lumen Emperor.
The Weaver of Existence.
The Weaver of Extremity..."

The scene that unfolded carried mixture of grandeur and absurdity as...just as THE Dead Order had introduced herself through accumulated titles, Noah proceeded to do precisely the same but with far more exaggerated length.

He listed multiple grand designations with his voice maintaining perfect seriousness, his gaze remaining calm while THE Dead Order observed him with eyes beginning to shine with what might have been amusement beneath her careful composure.
The Gazer of the Unscalable Wall.
The Indefatigable." He paused as if mentally cataloguing.
"Let me see, is that everything?
Ah, no.
There are more.
The Dreamer of Extremity.
The Dream of The Beyonder.
The Burnt One.
The Cartographer of Existence.
The Stranger.
The Outsider..."
He let final titles settle with deliberate weight:
"The Early Creature, Osmont."
He had conducted such lengthy introduction that when he finally concluded, both Sigrid and THE Dead Order were regarding him with expressions mixing bewilderment and incredulity at the sheer
audacity of matching her formal presentation with such an
elaborately constructed response.
And in the silence following this performance, THE Dead Order spoke.
"You... are one of the primary reasons my Civilization is facing existential threat at this moment?
You?"
The emphasis on that final word suggested difficulty reconciling the being before her...however unusual, with the scale of disruption
apparently being caused.
At such question, Noah nodded with perfect calm and utmost seriousness.
"Yes, Ma'am.
And no, I don't believe The Resurgence of your Order, as you've termed her, I don't think she possesses capability to cease
siphoning from you.
In fact..."
His smile widened slightly with an expression mixing tyrannical confidence and deliberate provocation.
"I think we'll amplify the process considerably."
BOOM!

An unfathomable phenomenon manifested as Noah and Sigrid came face to face with a terrifically powerful being possessing THE distinction...an entity who should theoretically be capable of collapsing them through mere attention!
And yet... neither side could harm the other!
Oh!
After Noah's bold proclamation, a heavy silence settled across the unique liminal space separating them from THE Dead Order.
The silence did not persist for an extended duration as Noah floated calmly through the conceptual space to more closely observe the river of white Order flowing steadily into Sigrid's existence.
The current maintained consistent velocity, neither accelerating nor diminishing despite the charged circumstances.
He turned to look deeply into Sigrid's eyes, searching for signs of strain or corruption, confirming she was managing the influx without
anything catastrophic.
She nodded with subtle gesture that conveyed reassurance.
Satisfied by this confirmation, Noah turned to directly face THE Dead Order's massive illusory form.
When he spoke again, his voice carried imposing calm as he began to bullshit.
"I have always felt profound sympathy for Order, truthfully.
The first victim of THE Living Paradox's ambitions.
Falling in a battle where you were only attempting to do what was fundamentally right.
And what compensation did you receive for such righteous dedication?
Collapse.
Absolute termination."
His gaze intensified.
"Why did you have to be the one to perish?
Why not Origin?
Why not
Emotive?
Why not Spirit or any of the other THE entities who participated in that conflict?
And worst of all, after that grand show of force concluded, with THE Living Paradox being imprisoned
thereafter as a consequence... why was it that THE Living Emotive and others simply turned away and subsequently collaborated with THE Living Paradox to forge THE Loom?"
BOOM!
Noah's voice dropped with weight of an utterly damning assessment.
"It effectively rendered your sacrifice and death worth absolutely nothing.
Your collapse became a meaningless footnote in a grand narrative rather than martyrdom that changed trajectories.
You entire existence amouted to...absolutely... nothing."
BOOM!
His words landed with immense weight!
On the opposite side of The Veil, THE Dead Order received these observations with a calm smile!
"You say the truth with remarkable clarity, O True Emperor of Quintessence.
My Collapse meant nothing in ultimate accounting.
My sacrifice accomplished nothing beyond providing THE Living Paradox
with lesson about consequences...lesson he apparently learned well enough to avoid similar miscalculation subsequently."
Her expression shifted subtly.
"That...is precisely why Order remains so critically important.
Had I
been present during THE Loom's construction, perhaps it would never have reached fruition.
Perhaps if I possessed all my accumulated power at current developmental level, I could even prevent The Fallout entirely."
She leaned forward with interest intensifying.
"That is what you are attempting to accomplish, correct?
You should
be systematically growing your budding Civilization because that represents the most straightforward pathway to attaining THE distinction.
If you achieve THE, you possess genuine chance to survive The Fallout rather than becoming fuel for others' continuation."
Her smile took on dangerous edge as her massive face approached the
Veil more closely.
"But consider this alternative, 9th Infernal Lord, Imperius Avallonis,
The Antediluvian, The Lumen Emperor, The Weaver of Existence..."
She deliberately invoked multiple titles he had claimed.
"I am positioned right here before you.
I already possess THE distinction through refinement across eons.
I simply require modest infusion of vitality to restore capabilities that were stripped during my collapse." Her eyes gleamed with a calculated offer.
"Can you provide that essential essence?
Can you provide me with...her?
I already carry THE distinction.
With my counterpart currently drawing from my reserves, once we reunify and become one...that represents your optimal solution to The Fallout immediately available.
I would then possess capability to rectify numerous wrongs, to restructure existence's trajectory.
I could even share with you knowledge of the many alternative pathways to reach THE beyond
simple Civilization construction." She paused deliberately.
"Existence is vast beyond normal comprehension.
Building a
Civilization constitutes the fastest and most straightforward methodology, certainly.
But alternatives exist for those with sufficient intelligence and flexibility to pursue them.
What do you say, Weaver
of Extremity?
Dreamer of Extremity?"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4423 Primordial Civilizations I
paragraphs: What did he say?
He was asked so simply to give up Sigrid!
At this moment, Noah shook his head with a gesture of regret and firm refusal.

"I have grown excessively attached to relinquish my Order now. She has become rather... integral to my existence. However, consider this alternative approach: did you sense how your former friend...your killer, the direct cause for your current Dead status...did you perceive how THE Living Paradox manifested on this side of The Veil recently?" His expression shifted toward a strategic proposition.
"How about we collaborate on addressing that particular problem? You understand the principle: the enemy of my enemy is my
friend...or something like that. We could coordinate efforts against THE Living Paradox rather than competing..."
Noah articulated such proposal, but in response, THE Dead Order simply stared at him with cold expression offering no verbal reply whatsoever.
Her silence spoke volumes about her receptiveness to that particular suggestion!
Oh!
Observing her unreceptive demeanor, Noah continued with shift in approach...this time becoming deliberately provocative.

"I encountered THE Living Paradox when he manifested over here and I somehow managed to survive the experience sufficiently to relay this account. Would you like to know precisely how I accomplished that improbable feat?"
He paused for effect.

"And I must say, having met him directly and now meeting you in this manner... THE Living Paradox is substantially more terrifying to observe and interact with. An entity genuinely worthy of fear...if I still experienced such a limiting emotion."
"Compared to his overwhelming presence, you seem rather... diminished, O Order. Like a lesser version of an existence carrying THE distinction, you understand?"
His voice took on a contemplative quality mixing observation with deliberate insult!
"When he appeared, even existence itself was manifesting commands: 'KNEEL! REVERE!"

"Reality itself bent to acknowledge his authority. But with you present now... ah, you are remarkably easier to be around, Order. More manageable. Less oppressive. Is this perhaps why THE Living Paradox has been consistently winning across eons? Because you and the other THE entities are simply...lesser?"
BOOM!
At these deliberately provocative words, THE Dead Order looked at him with calmness before transforming into a face of amusement.
She began laughing, the sound echoing across the liminal space with volume!
HUUUM!

"Remarkable! I never anticipated something so diminutive and recently manifested could address me with such audacious disrespect. It actually hasn't occurred... ever? Across my entire existence spanning incomprehensible duration, no entity has spoken to me with such casual dismissiveness!"
At such observation, Noah nodded calmly.
"Yeah, it's remarkably easy to speak provocatively when there exists
an impenetrable barrier between us. The Veil provides a substantial confidence booster!"
THE Dead Order approached the Veil even more closely, her massive face locking onto Noah's comparatively tiny form with intensity.
"Haha! I find myself appreciating you despite the obvious provocations. Your audacity is almost... refreshing. Almost."
Noah replied with a casual nod as he floated beside a visibly cautious Sigrid who continued maintaining vigilant observation of THE Dead Order despite ongoing power transfer.
He patted Sigrid's head to calm her existence.
"Yeah, your counterpart appreciates me too. We have quite a
compatible relationship, actually."
Her counterpart appreciates him too.
At these specific words, THE Dead Order blinked with sudden shift in
demeanor.
She looked between Noah and Sigrid with expression rapidly transforming from amusement to dawning comprehension!
Her eyes flashed with ferocious light.
"Wait... you haven't been..."
Noah blinked with expression of confusion, tilting his head with an
innocent gesture.
"What?"
The expression of THE Dead Order became stern and heavy for the first time since their interaction commenced, amusement completely evaporating as she demanded.
"You... haven't been desecrating Order through a carnal relationship,
correct? Tell me explicitly...that you haven't been fucking my Order! Tell me you have not been tainting something so profoundly sacred with base physical gratification!"
BOOM!
Noah felt genuine astonishment at this unexpected line of
questioning.
He hadn't anticipated such concern manifesting from being apparently focused on Civilization scale conflicts.
But recognizing opportunity to further destabilize THE Dead Order's composure for information, he continued.
"Well... my mother raised me not to engage in lies, so I won't fabricate comfortable lies. Perhaps there has been... modest tainting involved."
The expression of THE Dead Order visibly soured as she said with
cold precision.
"Modest?"
Noah sighed as if caught in a transparent deception, and he adopted
the tone of reluctant confession.

"Okay, perhaps extensive tainting would be more accurate characterization. But don't concern yourself excessively, it's all conducted in the most sacred manner possible, with appropriate reverence for everything involved."
HUUM!
On the opposite side of The Veil, billowing power began gathering with threatening intensity as white brilliance rose around THE Dead Order's form like storm preparing to break.
A flash of genuine anger appeared in her eyes for the first time during
their interaction as she shook her head with a gesture mixing disbelief and mounting fury.
"Haha... this... THIS is precisely why this magnitude of power cannot be entrusted to lesser beings! You don't even comprehend what to do
with it appropriately! You actually taint it continuously, day after day, your limited minds utterly unable to wrap around the immensity of
what you have gained access to!"
Her voice intensified with conviction. "This is exactly why you cannot possess Order, you imbecilic creature! You fundamentally do not understand the immensity of one
of the Original Civilizations! One of the Primordial Civilizations that
existed before all others!"
Original Civilizations?
Noah's eyes flashed sharply with sudden intense focus.
Primordial Civilizations?
Order, Paradox, Emotive, and others classified under such
designation?
Was his own Civilization, The Primordial Civilization of Mana and
Hunger, also not considered authentic Primordial Civilization despite
the nomenclature?
He had finally extracted substantive information from THE Dead Order beyond tactical posturing, and he wanted considerably more! "Woah, woah, woah," Noah said with his voice shifting toward

conciliatory tone, "we were maintaining such productive conversation...let's not become hostile now over relatively minor details. Don't allow that tainting situation to divert us from more significant discourse. Come on now."
His eyes shone with luminous intensity as he pressed on.
"What precisely don't we understand about the immensity of these
grand Primordial Civilizations? This imbecilic mind of mine would love to wrap my head around it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4424 Primordial Civilizations II
paragraphs: Noah had inquired about Primordial Civilizations!
THE Dead Order regarded him with cold intensity, her expression seemingly still processing his admitted transgression against what she considered sacred principle.
Her eyes burned as if she was determining how to proceed given her inability to directly punish behavior that genuinely offended her foundations.
"If you cease the siphoning of my Order immediately, I will reveal certain information to you. Information regarding Primordial Civilizations and their fundamental distinctions from lesser
frameworks. That seems...to be an equitable exchange given current circumstances."
Her tone wanted absolutely no negotiation, presenting this as reasonable compromise rather than request!
But...
At such proposition, Noah shook his head with gesture of amusement and absolute refusal.
"No. That's not happening."
Stop the siphoning? Hah!
The very suggestion bordered on absurd given how advantageous the current arrangement proved for their development.
He elaborated with finality.

"However, you must possess considerable curiosity regarding THE Living Paradox and his recent manifestation. I will share the comprehensive details of my encounter with him...including his aims and objectives. He may have actually mentioned you specifically during our interaction, which I imagine would prove rather illuminating from your perspective.."
Not an iota of shit was mentioned regarding THE Dead Order, but it was good to fluff things up!
The mention of THE Living Paradox caused THE Dead Order to become instantly silent, her cold expression shifting towards genuine interest beneath her careful composure.
After brief contemplation, she said simply.
"Okay. That exchange I will accept."

She looked between Noah and Sigrid as if deliberately filing away his admitted desecration of Order for future consideration...placing it in mental storage rather than dwelling on something she currently lacked power to address.

"Originally, my Guiders of Order were already mobilizing toward The Lands of The Living to investigate both THE Living Paradox's appearance and your unusual emergence. But since I have you positioned before me now, I can redirect them toward more immediately important matters."
Her expression hardened slightly with implicit threat.
"That arrangement persists until such time as I successfully cross to the other side to ensure you all cease this siphoning...should you persist in maintaining it indefinitely."
Noah's eyes flashed sharply.

There exists something THE Dead Order considers more important than addressing Sigrid and THE Living Paradox's manifestation? What could possibly warrant higher priority than those existential concerns?
After articulating this veiled warning, THE Dead Order waved her
hands.
Behind her massive form, a tremendous white throne materialized, constructed from marbled pillars of pure Order that assembled
themselves.
She proceeded to seat herself upon it with regality, her figure emanating profound waves of majesty that made the surrounding conceptual space adjust to acknowledge her sovereignty.
When she spoke again, her voice was grand!

"For you to genuinely comprehend what it means when discussing Primordial Civilizations, you don't require lengthy theoretical exposition. You simply need to experience a conversation I once shared with THE Creature himself...his words always illuminated more than any explanation ever could."
A conversation that Order had with THE Creature.
Noah's eyes intensified with focused interest as he asked immediately.
"When would this conversation have occurred?"
THE Dead Order smiled with an expression mixing nostalgia.

"Time doesn't truly matter in the grand scheme of existence's trajectory, but for specificity: this exchange occurred shortly before the completion of THE Loom. At that juncture, THE Creature had grown nostalgic regarding the distant past...The Lands of The Dead had long been established as separate domain, and he appeared before me carrying sense of profound melancholy."
Her voice shifted, taking on a quality suggesting she was channeling THE Creature's actual words.

"He asked me: 'Why is it that with grander and grander complexity, we progressively lose the fundamental simplicity of existence itself? Do you remember the truly earliest times? When Origin first introduced herself to me with such innocent enthusiasm? When Concept emerged and made things delightfully easy to understand?" "When Inevitabilities seemed like formidable monsters worthy of genuine concern rather than manageable nuisances?"
She paused, allowing the weight of those questions to settle.
"Why could we not retain that same beautiful simplicity as we advanced? Why must sophistication invariably breed complications that obscure rather than illuminate?"
HUUM!
THE Dead Order's smile carried a mixture of regret and
self-recrimination as she continued.
"At that time, I was not in optimal mental state...I was still processing
my own collapse. So I replied with unfortunate bluntness"
"You happened, O Creature. You gave away your Everythings and initiated the race of Civilizations. This entire catastrophic trajectory
traces back to your fundamental generosity."
BOOM!
THE Creature began the race of Civilizations?
The revelation landed with seismic implications!
THE Dead Order shook her head with a gesture holding lingering
shame.

"I immediately regretted having said such an accusatory assessment to a being who was dedicating everything toward collective benefit. But he seemed to understand my emotional state rather than taking offense. He only smiled with that characteristic patience and nodded before responding...
Her voice shifted again, channeling THE Creature's reply.
"Yes, all of this can reasonably be considered My fault in ultimate

accounting. I set things in motion through my choices and actions. I deliberately allowed everything to be free...for entities to pursue what they wished, to explore the endless expanse of existence according to their own determinations rather than my imposed structure."
She paused significantly.
"If I had reigned things in early, exercised controlling authority when
initial problems emerged... perhaps The Primordial Civilization of Paradox would not have expanded so rampantly. If my own Primordial
Civilization wasn't left to operate freely, maybe none of this would be
transpiring. Maybe. Maybe. Maybe."
BOOM!
When she reached this point in her recollection, THE Dead Order
looked directly at Noah from her white throne with her eyes carrying the weight of revelation about to be delivered.

"The Primordial Civilization of THE Creature was so immense, so fundamentally threatening to basic continuation, that Paradox felt unfathomably intimidated. Little Thing...do you comprehend what the Primordial Civilization of THE Creature actually represents? What it
was? What it is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4425 Primordial Civilizations III
paragraphs: Noah remained deliberately silent, recognizing this as a rhetorical prelude rather than a genuine question requiring a response.
She continued with her voice booming with regal authority.

"THE Creature gave his Everythings to Existence all those eons ago...distributed his fundamental essence across reality's totality. It was channeled initially through Paradox. But even Paradox could not contain it completely, could not bottle something so vast."
WAA!
Her eyes blazed with white brilliance.
"So his Everythings spread throughout Existence itself...permeating everything, becoming foundation upon which all else was
constructed. THE Creature's Civilization... is THE PRIMORDIAL CIVILIZATION OF EXISTENCE!"
BOOM!
The words landed with such tremendous philosophical and existential weight that both Noah and Sigrid's forms buzzed!
THE Primordial Civilization of Existence!
Noah's mind raced through implications.
How immense must that be? How incomprehensibly powerful? How overpowered?!
If that designation is accurate...if his Civilization genuinely encompasses Existence itself...
Then he cannot possibly be Dead. If his Civilization was the very framework of Existence, then his termination would mean reality's collapse. He must persist in some form, somehow, somewhere. BOOM!
The logic seemed inescapable even if mechanisms remained mysterious.
As Noah
essed these sh ting revelations on his side of the transparent veil, THE Dead Order observed them.
She settled more comfortably upon her throne before beginning a comprehensive explanation.

"To properly understand Primordial Civilizations, you must recognize they emerged from the earliest throes of existence itself...before conventional time, before established causality, before the weavings that now seem fundamental were even conceived."

"The Primordial Civilizations are... THE Creature's Civilization of Existence, serving as foundation for literally everything. The Primordial Civilization of Hunger...THE First Hunger's framework that established appetite and growth as principles. The Primordial Civilization of Paradox...contradiction and impossibility given structured form."

"The Primordial Civilization of Origin, beginnings and genesis as organized authority. The Primordial Civilization of Concept, categorical understanding and definitional frameworks. The Primordial Civilization of Emotive, feeling and passion structured systematically. The Primordial Civilization of Spirit, essence and vitality as coordinated whole. Alongside all the others."
She paused for emphasis.
"And of course, The Primordial Civilization of Order...my weavings that established structure and systematic organization."
Oh!
Her expression intensified as she continued!

"These Primordial Civilizations don't merely occupy portions of existence...they permeate the vast expanses of reality itself. They are woven into the fabric of how things operate. Any Civilization that emerges subsequently, regardless of refinement or accumulated
power, cannot genuinely compare because they are built upon foundations that Primordial Civilizations established."
She leaned forward with intensity:

"Primordial Civilizations possess inherent advantages that cannot be replicated through cultivation. First...they carry precedence- they existed before alternatives, which means Existence itself recognizes their authority as more fundamental than competing Civilizations." "When a Primordial Civilization conflicts with newer structure, existence defaults to honoring the elder claim. Kids like you may start questioning soon why Existence is unfair...Existence is not set up to support you. Never you."
HUUM!
Her fingers drummed against her throne's armrest with a measured
rhythm.

"Second: they maintain permeation- their principles extend throughout existence rather than being localized to specific domains or followers. My Order influences how things naturally organize across all territories, not just where my active attention focuses. I gain weavings even in places I have no infleunce in...even in The Lands of
The Living!"
"Paradox introduces contradiction into fundamental operations regardless of THE Living Paradox's direct involvement."
She continued with building momentum!
"Third: they possess irreducibility...you cannot break them down into
simpler components because they themselves represent the simplest possible expression of their Weavings."
WAA!
"Order cannot be reduced to a more basic organizational concept. Existence cannot be decomposed into something more fundamental. They are axiomatic rather than derived."
OH!
Her voice intensified further as if to say she was not fucking done!
"Fourth: they demonstrate inevitability...attempting to eliminate Primordial Civilizations is functionally equivalent to attempting to eliminate the principle it embodies from reality itself."

"You cannot remove Paradox without eliminating contradiction from existence. You cannot destroy Origin without preventing all beginnings. The concepts and the Civilizations are inseparable at fundamental level. So all the Civilizations that THE Living Paradox Collapsed...they are not truly gone. They cannot be. Suppressed. Decimated. Collapsed. Use whatever words you want. But they are here. They will be here."
An immense silence settled as she said this.
Noah's eyes pulsed with waves of glorious majesty.
And THE Dead Order...
She gestured broadly.
"Fifth: they enable Existential Communication...all beings across
existence comprehend their principles instinctively because those principles are woven into how consciousness itself operates. Everyone understands what Order means. Everyone grasps Existence
as concept."

"This provides Primordial Civilizations with influence that transcends....absolutely everything. You know my Order. You know Paradox. Even without me doing anything, I have likely fed off any actions you or countless other creatures made...aligning with Order." "I feed off of Order across Existence right now, though I am limited
when it comes to access to THE Loom. But at this very moment, I am feeding on such a steady stream of Order that even what you two are siphoning is negligable...for now anyways!"

"It is why I am not too enraged...yet. You are like mosquitos...harmless fucking things, for now. But you could become a major annoyance. It is also why I am not afraid of the future as Order will always be there. When THE Loom opens and all the eons of Order within it flood out...I will feed off of it and become my most powerful."
BOOM!
"Concepts. Origins. Emptive. Paradox. They are Primordial. They
collect from all of Existence. Anything paradoxical you did...you fed paradox. And all of Existence...all of Existence feeds THE Creature."
BOOOM!
Her expression became almost pitying!
As if all of them never truly stood a chance!
After completing this extensive exposition, THE Dead Order crossed
her legs with a gesture suggesting conclusion of a lesson as she delivered final assessment.
"That is what a Primordial Civilization represents. Whatever framework you have constructed...however impressive it may seem relative to scattered individuals, it does not possibly compare to what
I have described. It cannot possibly compare because it lacks the fundamental advantages that only emerge from being woven into existence's basic architecture from its inception."
BOOM!
Her words landed with finality meant to establish absolute hierarchy,
to demonstrate the insurmountable gap between what Noah was building and what she represented!
Noah's eyes flashed sharply at this comprehensive dismissal as he suppressed his devilish smile with considerable effort!
He could feel his existence buzzing as if something immense was
about to explode!
How could my framework not compare when I already possess not
one but TWO emerging Primordial Civilizations?! The Primordial Civilization of Mana!
The Primordial Civilization of Hunger!
THE Dead Order didn't understand what she was actually facing.
Oh, she didn't understand!!!
