chapters.title: Chapter 4426 Primordial Civilizations IV
paragraphs: Noah had comprehensively absorbed the information regarding Primordial Civilizations as if it was akin to better understanding himself.
He was grasping the fundamental nature of the path he walked, The Way he was forging through existence's infinite expanse!
At this moment, his mind was buzzing with cascading revelations as his Existence pulsed with profound sense of Euphoria.
Oh, Euphoria!
It was not simple pleasure, but the recognition of truth that aligned perfectly with what he was becoming at deepest levels.
Glorious prompts bloomed within his consciousness.
CRITICAL ADVANCEMENT RECOGNIZED
You have grasped a fundamental understanding of your Way
Your comprehension of what you are building has deepened exponentially
You have advanced significantly along your chosen path through revelation rather than mere accumulation
The Way becomes clearer. The destination more defined. The journey more purposeful.
He had advanced in his Way!
Oh!
The realization settled with magisterial satisfaction as further prompts materialized, detailing profound implications!
And RUIN/EDEN's voice almost seemed to tremble with emotion as she expressed everything, as if even she found this far too grand and
unbelievable.
THE PRIMORDIAL CIVILIZATION OF MANA AND HUNGER -
RECOGNITION ACHIEVED
Your dual framework has gained comprehensive understanding of what it is truly capable of becoming
Analysis of Primordial Civilization characteristics have been understood in respect to your Civilizations.
FIRST QUALITY - PRECEDENCE:

Mana: Exists as fundamental building block preceding all sophisticated authorities. Before complex techniques, before refined powers, before elegant systems...there was raw Mana. Energy in its most essential form. Your Way of Mana Architect claims authority over this primordial essence, establishing precedence over all derivative authorities constructed from Mana as foundation.[

Hunger: Represents the original motivation driving all advancement. Before ambition was refined into philosophy, before desire became structured cultivation, there existed raw Hunger. The fundamental recognition of incompleteness. Your Way of Hunger claims dominion over this most basic drive, establishing precedence over all subsequent motivational frameworks.

When your Primordial Civilization conflicts with newer structures, existence will increasingly default to honoring your elder claim. Your Mana supersedes sophisticated authorities derived from it. Your Hunger takes priority over refined ambitions built upon it.
SECOND QUALITY - PERMEATION:

Mana: Your principles extend throughout existence rather than being localized to your direct sphere of influence. Wherever Mana exists, which is effectively everywhere, your Civilization maintains conceptual presence. You gain incremental advancement from Mana manipulation across all territories, not merely where you personally focus attention.

Hunger: Your framework influences how beings experience and express appetite across existence. Every act of cultivation driven by Hunger, every advancement pursued through desire...these feed into your Civilization's authority. You accumulate essence from Hunger expressed throughout reality regardless of whether those beings acknowledge your framework.

You will begin receiving passive accumulation from all Mana utilization and all Hunger expression across observable existence. This represents fundamental shift from active cultivation to passive accumulation through permeation.
THIRD QUALITY - IRREDUCIBILITY:|

Mana: Cannot be decomposed into simpler components because it already represents energy in its most fundamental form. You cannot reduce Mana to something more basic, it is axiomatic rather than derived. Attempting to break down your Mana authority becomes functionally impossible because there exists no simpler principle to reduce it toward.

Hunger: Represents the irreducible recognition of incompleteness. You cannot simplify Hunger into more basic concept because it already embodies the fundamental acknowledgment that drives all growth. Your Hunger authority cannot be deconstructed because it exists at bedrock level of motivational architecture.

Your Primordial Civilization possesses inherent resilience against deconstruction or systematic dismantling. Enemies cannot break down your framework into manageable components because the components themselves are irreducibly fundamental.
FOURTH QUALITY - INEVITABILITY:|

Mana: Attempting to eliminate your Primordial Civilization of Mana would require removing energy itself from existence. You cannot destroy Mana without collapsing reality's basic operations. Therefore, your Civilization demonstrates inevitability...it must persist because existence requires what it embodies.

Hunger: Attempting to eradicate your Primordial Civilization of Hunger would necessitate eliminating growth and advancement from reality. You cannot remove Hunger without preventing all progression. Therefore, your framework cannot be truly eliminated, only suppressed, only temporarily diminished, never permanently
erased.]

Even if catastrophically defeated, your Primordial Civilizations will persist in some form. They cannot be completely destroyed because the principles they embody remain inseparable from existence's fundamental operations. Suppression is possible. Decimation is achievable. But absolute elimination is functionally impossible.
BOOOM!
Oh, Master!]
RUIN/EDEN called out with emotion of immense relief!
Noah's existence buzzed as he felt a surreal sense of existence as...he felt like he found, no, grasped a solution of The Fallout.
Even if he failed. Even if he could not attain THE.
He would be similar to THE Creature or THE Dead Order...diminished, destroyed, suppressed...but not completely extinguished!
After eons or billions of years, he and his Civilization could rise again!
But even this...
I do not even want to be diminished! I do not want to be destroyed! It
is glorious to know this, but it changes nothing. A true solution that
does not accept destruction must be formed!
BOOM!
His thoughts burned with clear glory.
RUIN/EDEN was still immensely happy at this revelation as to her, her Master would never truly and completely die regardless of what these terrifying THE entities did in the future!
She collected herself...and then she continued.
FIFTH QUALITY-EXISTENTIAL COMMUNICATION: Mana: All beings across existence comprehend Mana instinctively

because manipulation of energy represents universal constant. Everyone understands what Mana means regardless of terminology variations. This provides your Civilization with influence transcending language, culture, or dimensional barriers.

Hunger: All conscious entities grasp Hunger as fundamental concept because recognition of incompleteness drives all advancement. Everyone experiences appetite for growth regardless of how they conceptualize or express it. This grants your framework universal accessibility that cannot be blocked by communication barriers. Your Primordial Civilization can influence and draw from all beings instinctively rather than requiring explicit teaching or conversion. Every act aligning with Mana or Hunger across existence feeds into
your framework automatically.
Through comprehensive understanding of these five qualities, you now comprehend what your Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger can potentially accomplish:|
-Existential influence without requiring direct presence -Passive accumulation from all aligned actions across existence
-Inherent resilience against systematic destruction
|--Automatic comprehension by all conscious beings -Fundamental authority superseding derivative frameworks Your path forward has crystallized with unprecedented clarity.

chapters.title: Chapter 4427 Primordial Civilizations V
paragraphs: After these extensive prompts settled into his consciousness, Noah felt his existence surging with power that threatened to explode outward in visible manifestation.
His body nearly erupted with radiance that would have been impossible to conceal, but revealing such dramatic transformation to THE Dead Order would expose information better kept hidden!
He contained the eruption internally with tremendous effort, suppressing most of the display through sheer disciplined will. But a portion still leaked despite his best efforts!

His body flashed with blue-gold brilliance as Primus Mana surged through every particle of his being with overwhelming concentration. An aura of profound ancientness began radiating from him...not the ancientness of accumulated years but of primevality, suggesting connection to existence's earliest moments!
The unmistakable signature of a Primordial Civilization leaked from him like light escaping through cracks in sealed vessel!
This development astonished THE Dead Order so profoundly that she rose abruptly from her white throne, her perfect composure fracturing as recognition struck with undeniable force.
Because she did not sense Order emanating from Noah to explain the presence of Primordial Civilization signature.
This was something else entirely...something she hadn't anticipated, nor did she recognize!
How could there be a Primordial Civilization...that she did not recognize?!
She voiced her astonishment aloud with rare display of genuine shock.
"How do you emanate the distinctive resonance of a Primordial Civilization?! You...who are you truly?!"
HUUM!
Noah couldn't answer at this moment.
His entire focus dedicated itself to containing and directing surging power rather than leaking it wastefully or allowing it to destabilize his carefully constructed weavings.
Sigrid moved behind him with fluid grace, her body embracing him from behind as her presence helped stabilize the tumultuous transformation.
Her own connection to Order provided grounding influence, calming the wild surges!
Additional prompts bloomed as the immediate crisis began settling.
DEVELOPMENT STATUS - PRIMORDIAL CIVILIZATION
RECOGNITION
Your budding Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger has not yet reached sufficient developmental level to fully enjoy all boons and standing of mature Primordial Civilizations
Current Maturity: Nascent Civilization|
HOWEVER:
Due to the heavy advancement of your Way that you have just achieved through comprehensive understanding, you can now access LIMITED BENEFITS of Primordial Civilization status
CURRENT ACCESS LEVEL: 10% of full Primordial Civilization standing and capabilities
This percentage will increase as your Civilization advances through systematic elevation and accumulated recognition to grander Designations.
JIMMEDIATE BENEFIT UNLOCKED:|
EXISTENTIAL COMMUNICATION AND PERMEATION OF THE PRIMORDIAL CIVILIZATION OF MANA AND HUNGER
All beings across existence comprehend and use Mana and Hunger principles instinctively because those concepts are woven into how consciousness itself operates
Everyone understands what Hunger means...the drive for growth, the recognition of incompleteness
Everyone grasps what Mana represents...fundamental energy, basic building block of sophisticated authorities
Across Observable Existence, all those who experience Hunger and feed their appetite for advancement...
All those who utilize Mana or similar energy-based authorities in any
form...]
ALL OF THEM will now feed into your Civilization automatically
Your Way of Existence gains passive accumulation from their actions]
CURRENT COLLECTION RATE: 10% of potential maximum
These boons will begin accruing... NOW.
BOOM!
The glorious scene that unfolded transcended simple visual
spectacle!
Noah felt like vast seas of concentrated essence manifesting around
him from countless different directions simultaneously.
Blue-gold Mana materialized in impossible quantities from
everywhere.
The accumulated Mana manipulation occurring across entire existence suddenly possessed conduit flowing toward him as focal
point.
Obsidian-crimson Hunger surged alongside it...concentrated appetite
and drive for advancement collected from innumerable beings pursuing cultivation through countless methodologies at this
moment!
Every expression of Hunger across reality contributed fractional essence that aggregated into overwhelming current.

These seas of collected authority flooded into him and immediately began surging toward his Foundation Palisades...his Civilization's framework drinking deeply of unprecedented influx, walls growing taller and more elaborate with each passing moment.
Simultaneously, additional recognition bloomed:
PERPETUAL HARVEST - UNPRECEDENTED DEVELOPMENT
DETECTED
The Principle is sensing thr commencement of the endless stream of
incoming harvests from all of Existence
This represents fundamental shift from finite accumulation to infinite
collection
Perpetual Harvest cheers with immense satisfaction at your
advancement of The Way!
All incoming harvest from Existential Communication and Permeation
will be amplified perpetually by Perpetual Harvest's inherent
capabilities!
This creates exponential growth curve rather than linear
accumulation
Your advancement velocity will accelerate dramatically from this
point forward
Existential Communication. Permeation!
The implications settled with weight that made even Noah's
tyrannical ambition pause!
Oh!
From this moment forward, any usage of Hunger anywhere in
existence would feed him fractionally.
Any utilization and understanding of Mana across reality's infinite expanse would contribute to his advancement.
Currently only 10% collection rate, certainly...but that percentage would grow as his Primordial Civilization matured.
And it translated to his framework beginning to gain identical boons and standing as those possessed by THE Creature, THE Living Paradox, THE Dead Order, and all other entities with mature
Primordial Civilizations!
The realization also emphasized sobering and horrific truth: across

countless eons spanning billions upon billions of years, THE Creature, THE Living Paradox, and all others with established Primordial Civilizations had been collecting these boons every single day without interruption.
Just how incomprehensibly immense are they, truly?
Feeling this scope and grasping the genuine magnitude of disparity,
Noah's existence buzzed with mixture of exhilaration and appropriate
humility.
Even he...with all his accumulated advantages, with Perpetual Harvest amplifying everything, with systematic optimization of every process....could not help but feel profound sense of immense weight
hanging far above him.
The weight of unfathomably developed Primordial Civilizations that
possessed countless eons of accumulated advancement while he... had only just begun.
The mountain he needed to climb had become visible in its entirety
for the first time, and its peak disappeared into heights that defied measurement.
But Noah smiled despite, or perhaps because of that daunting
recognition.
I have climbed impossible heights before. This merely represents the next ascension.

His body flashed with blue-gold brilliance as Primus Mana surged through every particle of his being with overwhelming concentration.

moment!

humility.

chapters.title: Chapter 4428 You Cannot Be Killed? I
paragraphs: Mana and Hunger positioned against Primordial Civilizations that had been enjoying countless boons across unfathomable expanses of time! When contemplating this vast disparity, Noah's mind naturally wandered toward Khor...The First Hunger whose existence had been fragmented and collapsed by THE Living Paradox's overwhelming power.
And yet... she had survived!
Somehow, across the wonders and mysteries of existence, Noah had manifested to serve as key facilitating her restoration.
Her Civilization, even when systematically collapsed, did not truly and completely cease existing.
That was the fundamental nature of the Primordial Civilization of Hunger demonstrating its Inevitability.

She was restored now, and Noah contemplated...when he shared these most recent discoveries regarding Ways of Existence and the five critical qualities of Primordial Civilizations... would she remember additional fragments of her collapsed memories?
Would her existence experience similar surge in advancement that he currently felt coursing through his own framework?
Because it seems Knowledge is extremely critical to everything.
The thought crystallized with profound significance.
Knowledge!
He possessed the Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger...with weavings carrying all inherent advantages THE Dead Order had described.
But because he had lacked specific knowledge regarding how these advantages actually functioned, he had been unable to properly
access their boons until this moment.
Only after obtaining particular understanding, only after advancing comprehensively on his Way, did he become capable of utilizing what he had always possessed.
It was akin to wielding ridiculously sharp sword while lacking knowledge of proper grip...possessing a devastating weapon that remained ineffective through ignorance of basic technique.
There could be hidden mechanisms in plain sight, sophisticated capabilities waiting to be activated, but they remained dormant if one didn't know they existed or how to trigger them.
Knowledge is critical! Understanding is paramount!
As he processed these layered revelations...
"Hey! I asked you a question. What are you?!"
The piercing voice of THE Dead Order echoed across the liminal space at this moment, her earlier shock transforming into demand for
answers.

She had sensed the brilliance radiating from his existence however briefly, had recognized the unmistakable signature of Primordial Civilization authority burning within his Mana with ancient grandeur. She questioned exactly what this could represent.
If she discovered that he possessed not merely this but another authority that would radiate identical primordial characteristics...
Noah shook his head while waving his hands with deliberate gesture, manifesting an illusory screen in the space between them.

He began displaying carefully filtered scenes from the encounter with THE Living Paradox in the Transcendent Quantum Folds...showing the entity's manifestation, his terrifying authority, the oppressive Festival of Paradox.
But he meticulously excluded any information regarding Khor's presence or her role in those events.
The scenes began playing with cinematic clarity as Noah said.
"A deal is a deal. You shared information with me that I genuinely wanted, and now I will reciprocate by sharing with you... intelligence regarding Paradox and his recent activities."

The illusions unfolded with detailed precision, and THE Dead Order, who had clearly wanted to continue her pointed questioning, looked at Noah with intense scrutiny before her consciousness locked onto the unfolding scenes he had laid out.
Her attention became consumed by observation, analyzing every detail.
While he kept her occupied with this distraction, Noah closed his eyes to sense the grand manifestation of his Civilization within his
internal landscape.
There, he felt the terrifying and constant flow of Civilizational Authority, both Mana and Hunger, streaming into his Foundation Palisades after being further elevated by Perpetual Harvest's
amplifying capabilities.
The harvest from Existential Communication and Permeation
combined into unprecedented influx!
It was utterly stupendous because Mana truly represented the base energy flowing across all of Observable Existence.
Every sophisticated technique, every refined authority, every complex manipulation...all of it ultimately derived from fundamental Mana as
building block.
For any actions related to Mana utilization, for any expressions of Hunger across Observable Existence, he would benefit and automatically collect fractional essence.
It was Taxation on the scale of Existence itself, and he didn't even
need to actively do anything beyond maintaining his Primordial Civilization's framework!
The realization painted vivid picture of just how terrifying mature Primordial Civilizations truly were.
THE Creature with his Primordial Civilization of Existence, which encompassed literally everything, must be collecting from absolutely all actions across reality simultaneously.
It hurts just to contemplate how incomprehensibly powerful he must
be.

That magnitude explained why he was universally acknowledged as strongest among THE entities despite their individual grandeur. And yet even against such unfathomably supreme being, Paradox had been audacious enough to plot systematic opposition and apparently achieve some measure of success.

Noah shook his head at the sheer immensity these beings represented as right after this contemplation, he felt his existence buzzing with renewed intensity as another elevation of power erupted within his
Existence.
Prompts bloomed with precision.
FOUNDATION PALISADES - CONTINUED ADVANCEMENT
Due to sustained influx from Existential Communication, Permeation,
and accumulated harvest:|
Your Foundation Palisades have forged their structure even further
PROTECTION THRESHOLD INCREASED:
Previous: 300 Quintillion Complexity and Purity required to harm
your existence]
Current: 500 Quintillion Complexity and Purity required to harm
your existence
Additionally: Attacker must be member of established Civilization|
Minor Mana and Hunger Palisades empowerment increased Previous: 35 Quintillion Complexity and Purity granted to recipients
Current: 45 Quintillion Complexity and Purity granted to recipients]
All blessed individuals will experience synchronized elevation
Noah observed these impressive numerical increases with satisfaction, a smile forming as he contemplated the constant flow of Civilizational Authority continuing indefinitely.
This will persist from now on, endless influx due to fundamental
nature of my Mana and Hunger!
And this represents only 10% collection rate as I need to advance
significantly further in my Way of Existence!

The metaphor was apt- he was accessing a vast sea of boundless potential, but currently drinking through narrow straw. He needed to expand that conduit tremendously to access proportional amounts of available essence.
He needed a big fucking straw!
He required additional knowledge for expansion. Needed to advance systematically on His Way through accumulated understanding rather than mere power accumulation.
As he processed these strategic considerations...
The scene Noah had projected concluded its display, and THE Dead
Order finished observing the carefully curated illusions.

chapters.title: Chapter 4429 You Cannot Be Killed? II
paragraphs: The expression of THE Dead Order carried mixture of recognition and dark amusement as she spoke.

"It really is that insane entity. Haha! Even if he currently inhabits Vessels and operates under suppression...whether imposed by Existence itself or through alternative mechanisms, your positioning on the same side of reality as that monster may indicate you don't possess much remaining time to live."
Her voice took on a quality mixing genuine warning with schadenfreude.

"Don't believe him when he proclaims he won't terminate you, that you're merely designated as future fuel for THE Loom. Provoke him sufficiently, irritate him beyond his tolerance threshold, and you may find yourself joining me on this side...crossing into The Lands of The Dead."
"Wouldn't that be delightful? Perhaps then you could finally explain why I sensed the unmistakable aura of a foreign Primordial Civilization emanating from you."
Her eyes narrowed with analytical intensity.

"It cannot genuinely be Primordial if it wasn't among the first frameworks to manifest. And since I do not recognize it from those earliest eras, it logically was not among the original formations. So you displaying that distinctive aura is paradoxical and should not be possible according to established principles."
At such pointed observation, Noah smiled with an expression mixing innocence and deflection.

"Perhaps you perceived something false...misidentification triggered by unusual circumstances. I suspect it was merely reflected light from Order itself, a residual signature from Sigrid's ongoing siphoning creating your uh...perceptual confusion. But I find myself curious
about something else entirely...
His voice shifted toward genuine interest.

"THE Primordial Civilization of Existence. Just contemplating its scope makes one feel infinitely small as... how did THE Living Paradox even possess sufficient audacity to oppose it directly and achieve successful outcome?"
His words caused THE Dead Order to pause momentarily before she settled back upon her white throne.
She crossed her legs with regal gesture while placing her chin upon her hand, white Order pulsing around her with magnificent authority as she responded.

"THE Creature was unquestionably strongest among all of us. But his Everythings passed through Paradox during that initial distribution, and that transfer made Paradox significantly stronger than the rest of us...though even enhanced, he couldn't genuinely compare to THE Creature's overwhelming supremacy."
Her expression became contemplative.

"So he plotted. He planned systematically across extensive duration. He turned multiple THE Living Existences against THE Creature through careful manipulation and whatever else. Many events transpired that a limited consciousness like yourself cannot fully comprehend through simple explanation. You are...tiny that way." Her voice intensified.

"But the ultimate result is this: Existence is asleep, Osmont. THE Primordial Civilization of Existence has been suppressed by THE Loom's combined authority. It will only fully awaken once more after The Fallout concludes. That is when the final confrontation to determine ultimate victor of the war between THE Living Paradox and THE Creature will transpire."
She leaned forward with emphasis.
"You, others like you, whatever Ways of Existence or Civilizations you walk..mall of it amounts to nothing compared to this fundamental conflict."
HUUM!

"You are spectators to grand existential drama, nothing more. You amount to nothing of consequence, and you will remain nothing regardless of your ambitious struggles. Do you fully comprehend that assessment, or shall I repeat it with additional clarity, Little Thing?"
Noah absorbed these potent waves of intelligence regarding THE Creature and THE Living Paradox with analytical focus, his mind
racing through implications.
Existence itself is asleep. Suppressed. Waiting to reawaken after The Fallout.
That explains why THE Creature hasn't simply resolved all conflicts through overwhelming force...he's constrained, diminished, operating at fraction of true capability...
On the opposite side of the transparent Veil, THE Dead Order's eyes pulsed with regality and concentrated power as she awaited response to her devastating assessment.
Noah smiled calmly and finally replied with a tone mixing calmness and unshaken confidence:
"No, no, I comprehend completely Ma'am. You don't need to repeat for emphasis. Though I do have one additional question arising from your comprehensive explanation."
His eyes gleamed.

"So...if Primordial Civilizations possess the quality of Inevitability, if they cannot be destroyed regardless of applied force...how can one actually kill someone like THE Living Paradox? Or terminate existence
of someone like yourself? Or any others who lead these supposedly indestructible Primordial Civilizations?"
Order scoffed at such inquiry as if the question itself demonstrated a fundamental misunderstanding.

"You imbecilic Little Thing. THE Living Paradox tried to kill me, and here I manifestly am. He killed THE Living Origin and extracted her Heart of Origin, yet Origin remains present throughout existence. Diminished certainly. Suppressed without question. Collapsed systematically. But very much present and capable of eventual restoration."
Her voice carried absolute certainty.
"You cannot kill me or any others leading Primordial Civilizations. There exists no methodology for achieving permanent termination of such beings. We are inseparable from principles we embody."
HUUM!
Her words landed with tremendous weight, proclaiming absolute
invulnerability!
And at such declaration, Noah felt his existence buzzing as if immense
and profound epiphany was blooming within his consciousness.
His Mana surged with euphoria as heavy, glorious drums began
beating in the surrounding space.
Drums heralding a Symphony of possibility!

The sense of revelation and euphoria surging within Noah during this moment of crystallizing insight caused a smile to begin forming across his features...an expression that started subtle but rapidly transformed into something far more pronounced!
A sound of Symphony boomed in the surroundings with tension-filled percussion that even THE Dead Order frowned upon hearing, recognizing something significant was occurring but unable to
identify precise nature.
And in the next moment, Noah began speaking with a voice carrying
the weight of revelation.
"Well what if..."
His expression transformed into absolutely devilish smile, his
crystalline white teeth showing prominently in smile that mixed triumph with cruel understanding!

The smile carved across his features with sharp definition, each visible tooth adding to impression of someone who had just discovered checkmate in a game an opponent believed unwinnable. His eyes blazed with the light of a predator recognizing vulnerability
in a supposedly invulnerable prey!
"What if you simply replace those Leaders of Primordial Civilizations? Can't kill them through conventional means, so just systematically take their place. Claim their Civilizations as your own!"
His smile widened impossibly further.
"Is my Sigrid here not potentially going to accomplish exactly that
against you? She's siphoning your Civilizational Authority continuously, growing stronger while you proportionally diminish. Eventually she takes your place as undisputed holder of Order's
framework, and after that transition completes..." He paused for devastating effect.
"You don't possess a Primordial Civilization of Order anymore,

someone else does! And at that juncture, you can die because you're no longer associated with any Primordial Civilization granting Inevitability! Your invulnerability vanishes the moment your framework transfers to another vessel! Hmm...hmm!"
BOOM!
His expression radiated unfathomable devilish satisfaction as opposite
him, THE Dead Order's features transformed into mask of utter rage, her composure shattering completely under the weight of his words!
